cabin.detail: Economy passengers can take one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 55 x 38 x 22 cm (Premium Economy: 10 kg, same size). When you board in India, Economy and Premium Economy passengers may carry only one piece, and its length, width and height together must not be more than 115 cm. Emirates doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in. Cabin bags must fit in the overhead locker or under the seat in front of you.

personal.summary: No separate laptop bag or handbag is listed for Economy from India: it's one piece only. Reasonable duty-free shopping is allowed on top

airlines.checkin_summary: 20 to 35 kg by fare; 1 or 2 x 23 kg to the USA
airlines.checkin_note: Flights between India and Dubai, Europe, the UK, Asia and Australia use the weight concept: you can split the total into as many bags as you like, but no single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and each bag's length, width and height together should be no more than 203 cm. Flights to and from the Americas (such as the USA and Canada) and Africa use the piece concept: you get a number of bags of up to 23 kg each in Economy, and each bag should be no more than 150 cm in total. A bag between 150 and 203 cm pays an oversize fee, and anything over 203 cm must go as cargo.
airlines.infant: An infant (under 2) gets one cabin bag of up to 5 kg (55 x 38 x 22 cm) and 10 kg of checked baggage, or 23 kg on flights to and from the Americas and Africa. You can also ask at check-in to take a fully folding stroller, a carrycot or an infant car seat to the aircraft free, if there's room. The allowance is printed on the infant's ticket. Emirates doesn't sell extra baggage on infant tickets.

excess.summary: Buy extra kilos online in 5 kg blocks, up to 50 kg, until 4 hours before departure; Emirates says this saves up to 45% on the airport rate
points: At the airport, Emirates lists USD 15 per kg between India and the Middle East or South Asia, USD 25 per kg between India and Europe or the Far East, and USD 40 per kg between India and Australia or New Zealand.

On piece-concept routes (USA, Canada), an extra bag of up to 23 kg bought at the airport costs USD 250 between South Asia and the Americas on tickets issued from 8 September 2026 (USD 225 on older tickets). Buying ahead online saves 15% on select routes, for up to 5 extra bags.
You can pay with Cash+Miles in Manage your booking. Extra allowance can only be bought on Emirates tickets (numbers starting 176) for flights Emirates operates.

sections.h: Emirates baggage from India to the USA and Canada
sections.p: These flights use the piece concept, so Economy Special includes only 1 bag of 23 kg, while Saver, Flex and Flex Plus include 2 bags of 23 kg each. A single 30 kg bag is not allowed on these routes even if your total is under the limit, so split heavy packing across two bags. Each bag should be within 150 cm (length + width + height). Emirates says a trip from Asia to the Americas that includes a sector in Europe or a stopover in Dubai of more than 24 hours uses the weight concept for the whole ticket; the baggage shown in Manage your booking tells you which applies to yours.

items: Sports equipment such as golf clubs, bicycles, ski gear, surfboards and SCUBA kit is accepted as checked baggage inside your normal allowance. Above it, normal excess baggage rates apply.
Tell Emirates at least 24 hours before the flight if you're bringing a bicycle. Any single sports item over 300 cm in total must go as cargo.

Emirates gives no special free allowance for musical instruments. An instrument can be checked in, taken in the cabin if it fits the cabin limits, or carried on a seat you pay for. Each piece must be within 300 cm in total.
Sporting firearms need Emirates' approval at least 3 days before the flight, and clearance from UAE Customs and the UAE Ministry of Defence to enter the UAE.

sections.p: Pets can't travel in the Emirates cabin (the only exception is falcons on some Dubai to Pakistan flights). A pet goes as checked baggage in the hold or as cargo. As checked baggage, Emirates lists USD 500 when the pet and cage together are up to 23 kg and 150 cm, USD 650 for 24 to 32 kg, and USD 800 above 32 kg. Contact Emirates well ahead for permits and vaccinations.

items: Online check-in opens 48 hours before the flight.
Emirates says that at most airports, check-in opens 3 hours before departure (up to 4 hours at some), so check your ticket for your airport.
In Dubai, clear passport control and security 90 minutes before departure and reach the gate 60 minutes before in Economy. Walking to the C gates can take up to 25 minutes.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged
items: Register a missing bag at the Arrivals baggage desk before you leave the airport. You get a reference number called a PIR, which you use to follow the claim on the Emirates website or app.
The Emirates app tracks your bags from check-in to loading, through a connection in Dubai, to arrival, and shows the belt number in Dubai.
To claim essential expenses for a delayed bag, contact Emirates within 21 days of getting the bag back, with receipts for the clothes and toiletries you had to buy.
Emirates asks you to fill in a Baggage Inventory Form listing what was in the bag; it can't be edited once sent. Tracing can take up to 21 days.
On a trip with more than one airline, the airline that flew the last sector handles the baggage claim.

sections.p: At Dubai Terminal 3, Emirates lists baggage wrapping at AED 40 per standard bag (AED 80 oversize), porters from AED 40, and left luggage from AED 35 per bag for up to 12 hours. Round bags, bundles, loose straps and bags with no flat side should be repacked in a cardboard box, which you can get at the wrapping kiosks before check-in.

notes: Power banks: since 1 October 2025 you can't use or charge a power bank on board. You may carry one under 100 Wh in your cabin bag, with its capacity shown, kept in the seat pocket or under the seat, never in the overhead bin. Power banks aren't allowed in checked bags.
Zamzam water: Haj and Umrah pilgrims whose trip includes Madinah or Jeddah may carry up to 5 litres in a sealed container, on top of their checked allowance.

Smart bags: a bag with a removable battery can go in the cabin if it is fully switched off, or in the hold if the battery is taken out and carried in the cabin. Smart bags with a battery that can't be removed are banned.

Medicines into the UAE: controlled medicines need approval from the UAE Ministry of Health before you travel. Carry the prescription and no more than 3 months' supply. (We last checked this on 3 November 2026.)
Skywards Gold and Platinum members get 1 extra bag on piece-concept routes, and Silver, Gold and Platinum members get extra kilos on weight-concept routes.

faq_extra.q: What is the Emirates baggage allowance from India to the USA?
faq_extra.a: Flights to and from the USA and Canada use the piece concept. In Economy, Special fares include 1 bag of 23 kg; Saver, Flex and Flex Plus include 2 bags of 23 kg each. Each bag should be within 150 cm (length + width + height). The cabin bag is 7 kg, and only one piece is allowed when you board in India.

faq_extra.q: What is the Emirates baggage allowance from India to Dubai?
faq_extra.a: Flights between India and Dubai use the weight concept. In Economy you get 20 kg on Special, 25 kg on Saver, 30 kg on Flex and 35 kg on Flex Plus, in as many bags as you like, with no bag over 32 kg. The cabin bag is 7 kg and 55 x 38 x 22 cm.

faq_extra.q: What is the Emirates baggage allowance from India to the UK and Europe?
faq_extra.a: The same as to Dubai, because these routes use the weight concept: 20 kg (Special), 25 kg (Saver), 30 kg (Flex) or 35 kg (Flex Plus) in Economy, with no single bag over 32 kg.

faq_extra.q: Can I carry a laptop bag on Emirates from India?
faq_extra.a: Not as a separate item in Economy. When you board in India, Emirates allows Economy and Premium Economy passengers only one cabin piece of up to 115 cm in total, so a laptop must fit inside your 7 kg cabin bag. Reasonable duty-free shopping is allowed on top.

faq_extra.q: What is the Emirates check-in baggage size?
faq_extra.a: On weight-concept routes (India to Dubai, Europe, Asia), each bag should be within 203 cm in total (length + width + height) and 32 kg. On routes to the USA and Canada each bag should be within 150 cm; a bag between 150 and 203 cm pays an oversize fee.

faq_extra.q: Does Emirates give extra baggage to students?
faq_extra.a: Emirates' baggage pages for India don't list a student baggage allowance, and we found no student offer page on its India website on 26 November 2026. Check the baggage shown for your fare before you pay.

faq_extra.q: How much does extra baggage cost on Emirates from India?
faq_extra.a: At the airport, Emirates lists USD 15 per kg between India and the Middle East, USD 25 per kg to Europe or the Far East, and USD 40 per kg to Australia. Buying online in 5 kg blocks up to 4 hours before departure saves up to 45%. On USA and Canada routes an extra bag costs USD 250 at the airport on tickets issued from 8 September 2026.

notes: Qatar Airways won't accept round or odd-shaped items, bags tied with rope or string, items wrapped in blankets or bags with loose straps. Carefully wrapped and sealed boxes within the limits are fine.

Zamzam water: up to 5 litres in approved bottles, only for Hajj or Umrah pilgrims flying from Jeddah, Madinah or Taif (from Qatar Airways' travel agent notice of February 2026).
Spare batteries go in your cabin bag only. Devices in checked bags must be fully switched off, not in sleep mode.
Privilege Club members get extra baggage: Silver 15 kg or 1 bag, Gold 20 kg or 1 bag, Platinum 25 kg or 2 bags.

airlines.seo_title: Qatar Airways baggage allowance from India: 7 kg, 50 x 37 x 25 cm

excess.summary: Buy extra baggage online, at a Qatar Airways office or through its contact centre more than 6 hours before departure to get the lower rate; from 6 hours to 1 hour before, you pay the higher airport rate
points: On weight-concept routes, extra baggage is sold in 10 kg bundles. At the airport, Qatar Airways lists USD 30 per kg from India to Qatar or the Gulf, USD 40 per kg to Europe or South-East Asia, USD 55 to Japan or Korea, and USD 60 to Australia and New Zealand.
On routes to the Americas, an extra 23 kg bag costs USD 255 at the airport (USD 345 for a 32 kg bag). A bag between 23 and 32 kg, or between 158 and 300 cm, costs USD 90 more.

Extra baggage bought online can't be refunded and is lost if you change your trip. It's valid only on flights Qatar Airways operates itself, and is charged in the currency of the country you fly from.
Qatar Airways doesn't publish the online discount on its India excess baggage page (read 26 Nov 2026), so compare the price in Manage booking with the airport rates above.

sections.h: How Qatar Airways differs from other Gulf airlines
items: Its cabin bag is the smallest of the big Gulf airlines: 50 x 37 x 25 cm, against 55 x 38 x 22 cm on Emirates, 56 x 36 x 23 cm on Etihad and 55 x 38 x 20 cm on flydubai.
It allows a checked bag up to 300 cm in total on weight-concept routes, more than Emirates' and flydubai's 203 cm.
It lets you carry two power banks, where Emirates, Etihad and flydubai allow only one.
Every Economy fare, even Lite, includes checked baggage. Etihad Basic and flydubai Lite include none.

sections.h: Qatar Airways baggage from India to the USA and Canada
sections.p: These flights use the piece concept. Economy Lite includes 1 bag of 23 kg, and Classic, Convenience and Comfort include 2 bags of 23 kg each, each up to 158 cm. Business and First include 2 bags of 32 kg. If a trip on more than one airline starts or ends in the USA or Canada, the baggage rules of the starting point apply to the whole trip. On flights from the USA, US security allows 1 cabin bag plus 1 personal item.

sections.h: Student Club: extra baggage for students
sections.p: Qatar Airways Student Club is free for students aged 18 to 30 at an accredited college or university, checked online through SheerID. Members get 10 kg or 1 extra bag, depending on the route, plus fare discounts of 10% on the first flight, 15% on the second and 20% on the third and fourth, and 2 free date changes. Up to 3 companions on the same booking get the same benefits. Join before you book, and check that the extra baggage shows on your ticket.

items: Sports equipment is free if it fits in your normal checked allowance. Above it, booked at least 6 hours before the flight, Qatar Airways lists USD 150 for up to 10 kg, USD 200 for 10 to 20 kg and USD 250 for 20 to 30 kg on weight-concept routes. Balls must be no more than 70% inflated.
Musical instruments can go in your checked allowance. A fragile instrument can fly in the cabin on a seat you buy for it, up to 75 kg and 120 cm per seat.

Dogs, cats and birds travel in the hold, not the cabin, for USD 450 per animal on most routes (USD 300 to and from Qatar), up to 75 kg with the cage. Ask at least 24 hours before the flight and carry a vet's fit-to-fly certificate from the last 10 days.
Falcons may travel in the Economy cabin (1 per passenger); from India to Qatar this costs USD 115. Emotional support animals are not accepted.
Online check-in opens 48 hours before the flight and closes 90 minutes before (24 hours before on US flights).
Self-service kiosks are listed at Bengaluru, Chennai, Delhi, Goa, Hyderabad and Mumbai, and automated bag drop at Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Mumbai.

Qatar Airways' India pages and conditions of carriage give no counter closing times for Indian airports (re-checked 28 Nov 2026), and Delhi Airport's check-in page gives none by airline. Check your ticket, and reach the airport 3 hours early for an international flight, as Delhi Airport advises.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged
items: Report it at the Qatar Airways baggage counter before you leave the arrivals hall, and keep the file reference number. You can follow the file online, or report online if you have already left.
Qatar Airways says most delayed bags are found within 24 hours and delivered to your home or hotel.
Its conditions of carriage set the deadlines for a written complaint: within 7 days of getting the bag for damage, and within 21 days of the bag being made available for a delay.

faq_extra.q: What is the Qatar Airways baggage allowance from India to the USA?
faq_extra.a: Flights to the USA and Canada use the piece concept. In Economy, Lite fares include 1 bag of 23 kg, and Classic, Convenience and Comfort include 2 bags of 23 kg each, each up to 158 cm in total. Business and First get 2 bags of 32 kg. The cabin bag is 7 kg and 50 x 37 x 25 cm.

faq_extra.q: What is the Qatar Airways baggage allowance from India to the UK and Europe?
faq_extra.a: These routes use the weight concept: 20 kg on Economy Lite, 25 kg on Classic, 30 kg on Convenience and 35 kg on Comfort, in as many bags as you like, with no bag over 32 kg.

faq_extra.q: What are the Qatar Airways cabin baggage dimensions?
faq_extra.a: 50 x 37 x 25 cm and 7 kg in Economy. Many 55 cm cabin trolleys sold in India are too tall for this, so measure your bag with its wheels and handle.

faq_extra.q: Is there a 40 kg baggage allowance in Qatar Airways economy?
faq_extra.a: Not on a standard India Economy fare, where the most is 35 kg (Comfort). Student Club members can get 10 kg more on weight-concept routes, and Privilege Club Silver, Gold and Platinum members get 15 to 25 kg more.

faq_extra.q: Does Qatar Airways give extra baggage to students from India?
faq_extra.a: Yes, through the free Student Club for students aged 18 to 30: 10 kg or 1 extra bag depending on the route, plus fare discounts. Join and verify your student status before you book.

faq_extra.q: How do I claim for a damaged bag on Qatar Airways?
faq_extra.a: Report it at the Qatar Airways baggage counter at the airport and get a file reference. Send the written complaint within 7 days of receiving the bag. For a delayed bag, the limit is 21 days from when the bag was made available to you.

Satellite phones and GPS devices (such as Garmin) need permission from India's Department of Telecommunications to be taken to or from India.
Strong-smelling fruit such as jackfruit and durian isn't allowed on Etihad flights.

Zamzam water: one package of up to 5 litres free, sealed in a plastic container inside a cardboard box sold at the airport. From Jeddah you need an Umrah or Haj visa. Only 100 ml is allowed in the cabin.

Etihad Guest members can choose extra baggage as a tier benefit (15 or 20 kg, or 1 bag, on higher tiers), but never on Basic fares.

Use Etihad's baggage calculator to see your allowance before you pay for more.

sections.h: How Etihad differs from other Gulf airlines
items: Basic fares include no checked bag at all; every Qatar Airways and Emirates Economy fare includes at least 20 kg.
Its top Economy fare, Deluxe, includes 40 kg: more than the 35 kg top Economy fare on Qatar Airways and Emirates.
Its cabin bag is 56 x 36 x 23 cm: 1 cm taller than Emirates' but 2 cm narrower.
Small cats and dogs can fly in the Economy cabin, which Emirates, Qatar Airways and flydubai don't allow.

sections.h: Etihad baggage from India to the USA and Canada
sections.p: These flights use the piece concept: Economy Value, Comfort and Deluxe include 2 bags of 23 kg each, Basic includes none, and Business and First include 2 bags of 32 kg. US Preclearance still runs in Abu Dhabi: you clear US immigration there, so be at Terminal A at least 4 hours before the flight and at Preclearance 2 hours before. Your bags are tagged through to your US airport.

items: Since 1 June 2026, one golf bag counts as part of your normal checked allowance. Skis, surfboards, bicycles and fishing and scuba gear also go within it, up to 300 cm in total.
A television of 40 inches or more pays a USD 100 oversize fee.
A small instrument can be your cabin bag. A larger one can go in the hold (up to 32 kg and 300 cm) or on a seat you buy for it (up to 155 x 22 x 43 cm and 75 kg).
Cats and dogs at least 16 weeks old can fly in the cabin, from USD 399 in Economy, if they weigh up to 8 kg with the carrier and the carrier is no more than 40 x 40 x 22 cm.
Send the request form 7 days before the flight and the documents 72 hours before, and check in 3 hours early.
From India, pets and service dogs can't fly to or from Ahmedabad, Kozhikode, Jaipur or Thiruvananthapuram, and falcons can't fly to or from Kochi.
Online check-in opens 30 hours before the flight.
In Abu Dhabi, Economy check-in opens 4 hours before departure and closes 60 minutes before.
Etihad's India pages don't give counter times for Indian airports, so check your ticket and arrive 3 hours early for an international flight.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged
items: Report it at the airport before you leave and get a Property Irregularity Report (PIR). You can track the bag on WorldTracer with its reference.
For damage, report it in writing within 7 days and send the claim within 21 days. For a delayed bag, claim for essentials within 21 days; a bag not delivered within 21 days counts as lost.
Etihad doesn't pay for damage to locks, zip pulls, wheels or side handles, minor scratches, or bags over 5 years old.
For valuable checked items, Etihad sells excess value cover: USD 125 for cover up to USD 2,500, with a declaration form shown at the airport.

faq_extra.q: What is the Etihad baggage allowance from India to the USA?
faq_extra.a: The USA and Canada use the piece concept: Economy Value, Comfort and Deluxe include 2 bags of 23 kg each, and Basic includes none. Business and First include 2 bags of 32 kg. The cabin bag is 7 kg and 56 x 36 x 23 cm.

faq_extra.q: What is the Etihad baggage allowance from India to the UK and Europe?
faq_extra.a: These routes use the weight concept: Basic includes no checked bag, Value 25 kg, Comfort 30 kg and Deluxe 40 kg, with no single bag over 32 kg.

faq_extra.q: What is the Etihad baggage allowance from India to the UAE?
faq_extra.a: The same weight-concept allowance: none on Basic, 25 kg on Value, 30 kg on Comfort and 40 kg on Deluxe, plus a 7 kg cabin bag on every fare.

faq_extra.q: What are the Etihad checked baggage dimensions?
faq_extra.a: Etihad's standard checked bag is up to 76 x 52 x 30 cm. A bigger bag pays an oversize fee, and no item may be more than 300 cm in total (length + width + height). Each bag can weigh up to 32 kg.

faq_extra.q: Does Etihad give extra baggage to students?
faq_extra.a: We found no current student baggage offer on Etihad's India website on 26 November 2026; its old student offer from 2021 has ended. Check the baggage on your fare before you pay.

faq_extra.q: How do I claim for damaged baggage on Etihad?
faq_extra.a: Report the damage at the airport and get a PIR, then report it in writing within 7 days and send the claim form within 21 days. Etihad doesn't cover damage to wheels, locks, zip pulls or side handles, or minor scratches.

A fourth bag pays a handling fee on top of excess rates. flydubai says the allowance may vary by route, so check your ticket. Zamzam water: from Jeddah, Madinah, Taif or Yanbu, up to 5 litres free on top of your allowance, sealed in approved packaging. From other Saudi airports, it counts towards your allowance.
Medicines into the UAE: controlled medicines need approval from the UAE Ministry of Health and Prevention before you travel. Carry the prescription and no more than 3 months' supply.
Skywards members get extra kilos when their fare includes checked baggage: Silver 12 kg, Gold 16 kg and Platinum 20 kg.

points: At the airport, flydubai lists AED 50 per kg between Dubai and India (AED 40 to 80 per kg on its other routes from Dubai). Some airports take cash only, and extra baggage at the airport depends on space.
flydubai doesn't publish an online price list: the price depends on your route, date and how early you buy. Extra allowance comes in 20, 30 or 40 kg steps.
Baggage add-ons can be cancelled only up to 24 hours before departure.

sections.p: flydubai flies to Dubai from 8 Indian cities: Ahmedabad, Delhi, Hyderabad, Kochi, Kolkata, Kozhikode, Lucknow and Mumbai. It flies from Dubai International Terminal 2, not Terminal 3 like Emirates. Its pages publish no India-only baggage allowance, so the fare table above applies, and your ticket shows the exact figure.

items: Lite fares include no checked bag. Every Emirates Economy fare includes at least 20 kg.
flydubai allows a small personal item (25 x 33 x 20 cm) as well as the 7 kg cabin bag; Emirates allows only one piece when you board in India.
Its cabin bag is 20 cm deep against Emirates' 22 cm, and the gate check is strict: AED 200 for each bag over the limit.
Pets can't travel at all, either in the cabin or in the hold (falcons only with approval).
Sports equipment is free within your checked allowance; above it, normal excess rates apply. Book it at least 24 hours before the flight. Each item can be up to 32 kg and 300 cm in total.

A musical instrument or other fragile item can fly on a seat you buy for it, in Economy only and one per passenger, up to 75 kg. Call flydubai at least 4 hours before the flight. The extra seat gets no baggage allowance.
Online check-in opens 48 hours before the flight and closes 75 minutes before. It isn't available on Umrah and Hajj bookings.

Airport check-in desks open 3 hours before departure and close 60 minutes before. flydubai gives this one rule for all its airports, including Delhi, Mumbai, Kochi and the other Indian ones, with no different time for India. Clear security at least 60 minutes before; gates close 25 minutes before departure.
At Dubai Terminal 2, Economy bag drop is at desks 17 to 21.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged
items: Report it at the baggage desk at your arrival airport before you leave, and keep the PIR number. If you couldn't, use flydubai's Contact us form within 7 days of arrival.
If the bag isn't found after 3 days, update the list of what's inside online. After 5 days, fill in the baggage inventory and claim form.
For damage, upload your boarding pass, a photo and a repair receipt within 7 days of getting the bag.
For a delayed bag, flydubai pays up to USD 50 a day for essentials, for up to 3 days, as a flydubai voucher. This isn't paid if you live in the country you arrive in.

faq_extra.q: What is the flydubai baggage allowance from India to Dubai?
faq_extra.a: In Economy, Lite includes only a 7 kg cabin bag, Value includes 20 kg of checked baggage and Flex 30 kg; Business includes 40 kg. You can split the checked allowance into up to 3 bags, each under 32 kg. Your ticket shows the exact figure for your route.

faq_extra.q: How many bags are allowed on flydubai?
faq_extra.a: One cabin bag of up to 7 kg plus one small personal item (25 x 33 x 20 cm) and a duty-free bag. If your fare includes checked baggage, you can split it into up to 3 bags.

faq_extra.q: What are flydubai baggage charges?
faq_extra.a: Bought online, flydubai says extra baggage is up to 70% cheaper than at the airport, where it lists AED 50 per kg between Dubai and India. A cabin bag over the size or weight limit at the gate costs AED 200 (USD 55).

faq_extra.q: Can I add baggage on flydubai after booking?
faq_extra.a: Yes. Add it in Manage booking up to 6 hours before departure, or during online check-in from 48 hours before. You can cancel the add-on only up to 24 hours before the flight.

faq_extra.q: Is there a 40 kg baggage allowance on flydubai?
faq_extra.a: Business Class includes 40 kg. In Economy, you can buy extra allowance up to 40 kg, and Skywards members get up to 20 kg more on fares with checked baggage.

airlines.name: Air Arabia

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg, plus a 3 kg personal item
cabin.detail: Every fare includes one cabin bag up to 7 kg and 55 x 40 x 20 cm, plus one personal item up to 3 kg. Duty-free shopping must fit within the combined 10 kg. A bag that is too heavy or too big is checked in at the counter, where excess fees apply, and if it is still over the limit at the gate Air Arabia may charge AED 100 a piece. Air Arabia doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: One personal item, such as a handbag, laptop bag or small backpack, up to 25 x 33 x 20 cm and 3 kg

checkin.allowance: No checked bag (you can pay for one)
20 or 30 kg (Air Arabia writes "20/30 kg")
30 or 40 kg (Air Arabia writes "30/40 kg")

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Basic; 20–30 kg on Value and 30–40 kg on Ultimate
airlines.checkin_note: Each bag must weigh no more than 32 kg and measure no more than 158 cm in total. A 20 kg allowance is one bag; 30 and 40 kg can be split into up to 2 bags. Air Arabia doesn't explain which of its "20/30" amounts applies to which route, so check your booking. You can add or upgrade checked baggage in steps of 20, 30 or 40 kg up to 12 hours before departure.
airlines.infant: With an infant under 2 you may carry one extra bag up to 3 kg for baby things. It must fit under the seat, and you declare it at check-in so it gets a personal item tag. A stroller can be used in the airport and is taken from you before boarding; Air Arabia says it isn't counted in your allowance if you hand it in at check-in with your other bags. Babies under 48 hours old aren't accepted, and no checked allowance for infants is listed.
notes: Power banks: up to two, each up to 100 Wh, in your cabin bag only. Keep them in the seat pocket or in a bag under the seat, not the overhead bin. They must stay switched off for the whole flight: you can't use one to charge a device or charge it from the seat.
Smart bags: the battery must come out, or the bag must be fully switched off. Bags with a battery that can't be removed are refused. E-cigarettes go in your cabin bag only.
Zamzam water: passengers flying from Saudi Arabia may carry one 5-litre bottle free as checked baggage, bought from approved outlets at the airport and sealed for air travel.
Carton boxes aren't accepted as checked baggage on Bangladesh flights or flights from Türkiye.
These rules cover Air Arabia's flights to and from the UAE, including Air Arabia Abu Dhabi.

excess.summary: Pre-booked baggage is far cheaper: Air Arabia says you save up to 90% against airport rates. At the airport, extra weight on flights to or from India costs AED 60–70 per kg
points: Pre-book 20, 30 or 40 kg online, through the call centre, at a sales office or with your agent, up to 12 hours before the flight. Prices vary by route and are shown when you book.
Airport rates per kg on Air Arabia's UAE flights (flight numbers G9 and 3L): AED 60–70 to or from India, AED 45–55 within the Gulf, AED 90–100 to Malaysia, Thailand or London, AED 70–100 to Europe.
If your bag still weighs more than what you bought, every extra kg is charged at the airport rate.
A TV of 40 inches or more costs AED 150 plus a handling fee; the largest TV accepted is 60 inches.

sections.h: How Air Arabia differs from other airlines from the Gulf
items: Basic fares include no checked bag. Emirates, Qatar Airways and Gulf Air include one on their cheapest India fares; flydubai Lite and Etihad Basic don't either.
You get a 3 kg personal item on top of the 7 kg cabin bag, so 10 kg in all. Many full-service Gulf airlines allow 7 kg in total.
Checked baggage is bought in steps of 20, 30 or 40 kg, and only up to 12 hours before the flight. After that you pay airport rates.
Power banks must stay switched off for the whole flight. Qatar Airways still lets you charge a phone from one you hold.

Air Arabia's baggage pages don't publish rules or fees for sports equipment. Check with Air Arabia before you fly with a bike, golf set or cricket kit, and expect it to count in your checked allowance.
No cats or dogs: the only animals Air Arabia carries in the cabin are falcons. They must be booked at least 48 hours before the flight and are charged three times the normal excess rate.
Online check-in opens 48 hours before the flight. If your airport isn't listed online, check in at the counter.
Airport counters open 3 hours before departure. Economy check-in closes 1 hour before (45 minutes for Business). Air Arabia doesn't list separate times for each Indian airport.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged
items: Report it to Air Arabia's baggage office or its handling agent at the arrival airport, before you leave the baggage hall if you can.
You get a Baggage Claim Reference Number. Keep it and your bag tags; Air Arabia sends updates by SMS and contacts you when the bag is found.
Time limits for claims are in Air Arabia's Conditions of Carriage. Under the Montreal Convention, a damaged bag should be reported within 7 days and a delayed bag within 21 days of getting it back.

faq_extra.q: What is the Air Arabia baggage allowance from India?
faq_extra.a: Every fare includes a 7 kg cabin bag and a 3 kg personal item. Basic fares have no checked bag; Value includes 20 or 30 kg and Ultimate 30 or 40 kg, shown on your booking.

faq_extra.q: What is the Air Arabia cabin baggage size?
faq_extra.a: 55 x 40 x 20 cm and 7 kg for the cabin bag, plus a personal item up to 25 x 33 x 20 cm and 3 kg. In inches that's about 21.7 x 15.7 x 7.9.

faq_extra.q: How much does Air Arabia charge for extra baggage from India?
faq_extra.a: At the airport, AED 60–70 per kg on flights to or from India. Pre-booking 20, 30 or 40 kg online up to 12 hours before the flight is much cheaper; the price is shown when you book.

faq_extra.q: Can I add baggage on Air Arabia after booking?
faq_extra.a: Yes. Add 20, 30 or 40 kg in Manage Booking, through the call centre or at a sales office, up to 12 hours before departure. Later than that, only airport rates apply.

faq_extra.q: Does Air Arabia allow power banks?
faq_extra.a: Yes, up to two of 100 Wh or less, in your cabin bag only and switched off for the whole flight. They are not allowed in checked bags.

airlines.carry_note: Air Arabia keeps [power banks](can-i-carry/power-bank.html) switched off for the whole flight, so charge your phone before you board. Zamzam water from Saudi Arabia goes free as checked baggage (see our [Umrah packing list](../guides/umrah-packing-list.html)). Bringing food or gifts home? See [sweets and home food](can-i-carry/sweets-and-home-food.html) and India's [customs allowance](customs.html).

airlines.name: Saudia

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Guest Class (economy) passengers may carry one handbag or briefcase up to 7 kg and 56 x 45 x 25 cm. It must fit in a closed overhead bin or under the seat in front, and gets a cabin baggage tag. Saudia warns that at a connecting airport the cabin bag may have to be checked in, because of the aircraft type or full overhead bins. Saudia doesn't say whether wheels and handles count, so measure them in.

personal.summary: One personal item on top, such as a coat, a tablet, a women's handbag, a stroller or baby cradle, or essential items for a guest with a disability. Saudia gives no size limit for it

checkin.fare: Guest Saver, Basic, Semi Flex and Flex
checkin.allowance: Shown only when you book; Saudia doesn't publish it by fare
Up to 23 kg and 158 cm in total; you can pay to raise one bag to 32 kg

airlines.checkin_summary: Depends on your fare and route, shown when you book; each economy bag up to 23 kg
airlines.checkin_note: Saudia's branded fares page (Guest Saver, Basic, Semi Flex and Flex) lists seats, miles and change fees but no baggage, so your free allowance is the one printed on your ticket. Each economy bag can be up to 23 kg and 158 cm in total. On India flights no bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and a bag over 205 cm in total must go as cargo; sports items of 205 to 300 cm are taken for a fee (Saudia's extra baggage notes, read 28 Nov 2026).
airlines.infant: Saudia's pages, including its conditions of carriage, don't list a checked allowance for infants (read 28 Nov 2026): the allowance is the one printed on the ticket, so check it. Saudia doesn't sell extra baggage or the 32 kg upgrade for infant tickets. Strollers are checked in free and travel in the hold. Newborns can fly after their first week; a baby older than 48 hours can fly with a medical certificate saying it needs no incubator or oxygen.
notes: Zamzam water: one package of up to 5 litres, only as a separate checked item, never inside your suitcase. It's free for everyone leaving Madinah (Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Airport); from other Saudi airports it counts within your free allowance.

Power banks: up to two, each up to 100 Wh, in your cabin bag only. You can't recharge them on board or use them to charge a phone or other device. Protect each one from short circuits: keep it in its box or a separate pouch, or tape over the terminals.

On flights to and from the USA and the UK, all electronic devices in the cabin are screened and you may be asked to switch them on. A device that won't switch on is not allowed on board, so charge your phone and laptop before you fly.

Travel update (read 27 Nov 2026): some flights to and from Riyadh are operating through Al Qassim and Dammam airports, with a Saudia bus to Riyadh included in the ticket. Check your flight status before you leave home.
airlines.seo_title: Saudia baggage allowance from India: 7 kg, 56 x 45 x 25 cm

excess.summary: Buy extra baggage in Manage booking on saudia.com or the Saudia app, where Saudia says it can be up to 30% cheaper than at the airport; on routes where online purchase isn't offered, you pay at the airport
points: Each extra bag you buy online comes as a voucher, valid for one year from issue.

Baggage Upgrade: in Manage booking you can raise a 23 kg bag to at most 32 kg on selected Saudia flights. It needs a confirmed booking and isn't sold for infant tickets. It can't be changed or refunded and is valid only for that flight; Saudia refunds it only if it delays or cancels the flight or doesn't give the service. Saudia shows the price only when you buy.
Extra bags you buy in Guest class can weigh up to 23 kg and 158 cm each; bigger bags up to 205 cm pay an oversize fee. Except on flights to and from the USA and Europe, no bag may weigh over 32 kg.
Vouchers can't be refunded, reissued or moved to a different flight time or route, and you lose the full value if you don't show up for the flight.
Saudia doesn't publish its excess baggage rates on its India pages (read 27 Nov 2026), so compare the online price with the airport counter before you pay.
Sports items over 158 cm cost USD 100 extra on international flights, or USD 167 in total if they are over 205 cm (up to 300 cm). To or from Canada, the fee is CAD 189 in total.

sections.h: How Saudia differs from other Gulf airlines
items: Its economy cabin bag is the widest of the Gulf airlines: 56 x 45 x 25 cm, against Emirates 55 x 38 x 22 cm, Etihad 56 x 36 x 23 cm, Qatar Airways 50 x 37 x 25 cm and flydubai 55 x 38 x 20 cm. Most 55 cm Indian cabin trolleys fit, if they weigh 7 kg or less.
Saudia doesn't print the free checked allowance for each fare on its website, unlike Oman Air and Gulf Air. Read it on your ticket before you pack.
It allows a free 5 litre Zamzam pack for everyone leaving Madinah, on top of the allowance. Qatar Airways allows Zamzam only for pilgrims, and most other airlines count it in your allowance.
Like Qatar Airways and Gulf Air, it allows two power banks; Emirates, Etihad and flydubai allow one.

sections.h: AlFursan members, USA flights and special cases
items: AlFursan Silver and Gold members (Elite and Elite Plus) get one extra bag free on international flights: up to 23 kg in Guest Class and up to 32 kg in Business or First.

Flights from the USA or Canada to Saudi Arabia allow only one carry-on item in all classes, up to 16 lb (about 7 kg) and 45 inches. Checked bags from Riyadh to New York, Washington, Los Angeles and Toronto must be sealed in safe wrap before check-in.
Kidney failure patients flying from Saudi Arabia can take up to 8 extra pieces of 32 kg each for their dialysis supplies, with the Saudi Center for Organ Transplantation card or a medical report.
Wheelchairs and crutches go free, plus up to two mobility devices (including an electric wheelchair) and one portable dialysis machine on top of the allowance.

Sports equipment and musical instruments count within your free checked allowance if they are packed in protective cases. Oversize items pay the fees in the extra baggage section above; items over 300 cm or 32 kg go as cargo.
Televisions and household appliances are accepted as checked baggage within the normal weight and size limits.

Cats and small birds can travel in the cabin, up to 5 kg with the carrier, in a leak-proof container of at most 52.5 x 32.5 x 40 cm, one pet per carrier. Dogs travel only in the hold. Saudia lists USD 100 for a pet in the cabin and USD 300 in the hold on international flights (not the USA or Canada).

Every animal entering Saudi Arabia must be registered on the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's NAAMA portal before travel, and live birds are restricted. Tell Saudia about a pet when you book.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged
items: Report it at the Saudia baggage desk before you leave the arrivals hall and keep the file number.
You can follow the bag with the Track Baggage service on saudia.com and send a claim with Saudia's online baggage claim form.
Don't pack valuables or important documents in checked bags; Saudia asks guests to keep them in the cabin.

faq_extra.q: What is the Saudia baggage allowance from India?
faq_extra.a: In economy you get one cabin bag of 7 kg and 56 x 45 x 25 cm, plus one personal item. The free checked allowance depends on your fare and route and is printed on your ticket; each bag can be up to 23 kg and 158 cm.

faq_extra.q: What is the Saudia cabin baggage size?
faq_extra.a: 56 x 45 x 25 cm (22 x 18 x 10 inches) and 7 kg in Guest Class. Business and First get a 12 kg handbag of the same size plus a 9 kg briefcase.

faq_extra.q: Can I carry Zamzam water on Saudia?
faq_extra.a: Yes, one 5 litre pack as a separate checked item, never inside your suitcase or in the cabin. It's free from Madinah; from other Saudi airports it counts within your allowance.

faq_extra.q: How do I track or claim for my Saudia baggage?
faq_extra.a: Report the problem at the Saudia desk at the airport first and keep the file number. Then use Track Baggage on saudia.com to follow it, and the online baggage claim form to claim.

airlines.name: Oman Air

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 7 kg
cabin.detail: Economy guests get one cabin bag up to 7 kg, with length, width and height adding up to no more than 115 cm. Oman Air doesn't give separate side limits, or say whether wheels and handles count.

personal.summary: Small extras are free on top: a handbag or purse, a coat or blanket, an umbrella, a small camera, reading material, a laptop in a small bag and a mobile phone

checkin.allowance: 20 kg to or from the listed Indian cities
30 kg to or from the listed Indian cities
40 kg to or from the listed Indian cities

airlines.checkin_summary: 20 kg on Super Saver, 30 kg on Comfort and 40 kg on Flex to and from India
airlines.checkin_note: These higher allowances apply to tickets to or from Mumbai, Kozhikode, Kochi, Delhi, Goa (Mopa), Hyderabad, Lucknow, Chennai, Bengaluru and Thiruvananthapuram. On other routes Super Saver has no checked bag (0 kg), Comfort 20 kg and Flex 30 kg. You can take as many bags as you like within the weight, but no single bag may weigh more than 32 kg (Oman Air won't accept it at all) or measure more than 158 cm in total.
airlines.infant: An adult with an infant gets 10 kg of extra checked weight on all fares except Economy Saver. Infant carriers, cots and strollers go free.
notes: In April 2026 Oman Air raised its India allowances: Super Saver now includes 20 kg, where it used to be cabin bag only.

Power banks: cabin bag only, never checked in. Don't use or charge them during the flight, and keep them under the seat or in the seat pocket. Power banks without a visible capacity label are refused.
Pack your things in a suitcase or similar container. Oman Air may refuse bags it thinks are badly packed.
Sindbad members get extra baggage in every class: Silver 10 kg or 1 piece, Gold 15 kg or 1 piece.
airlines.seo_title: Oman Air baggage allowance from India: 7 kg, 20-40 kg checked

excess.summary: Oman Air charges extra baggage per kg, by region. From India (the Indian Subcontinent) it lists USD 15 per kg to the Gulf, USD 20 to the Middle East and North Africa, USD 21 to Asia Pacific and USD 25 to Europe
points: These rates, read on Oman Air's India page on 27 Nov 2026, apply only to flights Oman Air operates itself, and start from the first extra kilo.
A bag of 160 to 210 cm in total pays an oversize charge even within your free weight; over 210 cm (up to 292 cm) it counts as large special baggage.

Special or sports baggage is charged per 23 kg piece: USD 311 from India to the Gulf, USD 414 to the Middle East and North Africa, USD 435 to Asia Pacific and USD 518 to Europe. Large special baggage (up to 32 kg) is USD 432, 576, 605 and 720.

For a trip that continues beyond the Oman Air network, the piece concept applies: an extra economy bag costs USD 100 for the first and USD 200 for each one after, plus USD 100 for a bag of 23 to 32 kg or over 203 cm.

sections.h: How Oman Air differs from other Gulf airlines
items: It gives no side limits for the cabin bag, only a total of 115 cm (length + width + height), against Emirates 55 x 38 x 22 cm, Etihad 56 x 36 x 23 cm, Qatar Airways 50 x 37 x 25 cm and flydubai 55 x 38 x 20 cm. A 55 x 35 x 23 cm trolley adds up to 113 cm and fits.
Its India allowances are among the highest in the Gulf: 20 kg on Super Saver, 30 kg on Comfort and 40 kg on Flex.
It sells extra weight per kilo from the first kilo, where Qatar Airways sells 10 kg bundles and Gulf Air 5 kg steps.
It never carries pets in the cabin, only in the hold or as cargo.
Sports equipment goes free within your allowance if it is no more than 300 cm in total. A golf bag over your weight pays the per-kg rate.
A small musical instrument (up to 7 kg and 115 cm) can replace your cabin bag; ask Oman Air at least 48 hours before the flight. Instruments in soft cases are not accepted, so use a rigid case.
TVs up to 43 inches and 23 kg count as normal checked baggage. From 44 to 55 inches (up to 32 kg) they pay a TV fee: USD 189 from India to the Gulf. Bigger TVs go as cargo.
Pets travel only in the hold or as cargo, never in the cabin, and are charged on top of your allowance.
From India to the Gulf, a small kennel with the pet (up to 23 kg and 203 cm) costs USD 150, a medium one (up to 45 kg) USD 250 and a large one (up to 75 kg) USD 438.

Reach the airport 4 hours early. A pet flying into Oman needs an import permit through the Bayan customs portal, a microchip, rabies vaccination and a rabies antibody test; some breeds, including Pitbull, Rottweiler, Doberman and Great Dane, are banned.
Online check-in opens 48 hours and closes 60 minutes before departure.

Oman Air's check-in table lists counters opening 3 hours before departure at Delhi, Chennai, Kochi, Kozhikode, Hyderabad and Thiruvananthapuram, 3 hours 30 minutes at Bengaluru and 4 hours at Mumbai and Lucknow. At all of them, counters close 1 hour before departure.
Oman Air advises reaching the airport at least 3 hours before the flight.

faq_extra.q: What is the Oman Air baggage allowance from India in economy?
faq_extra.a: One 7 kg cabin bag up to 115 cm in total, plus checked baggage of 20 kg on Super Saver, 30 kg on Comfort and 40 kg on Flex on flights to and from the listed Indian cities. No bag may weigh more than 32 kg.

faq_extra.q: What is the Oman Air cabin baggage size?
faq_extra.a: 7 kg and up to 115 cm (45 inches) when you add length, width and height. Oman Air gives no separate side limits.

faq_extra.q: How much does Oman Air charge for extra baggage from India?
faq_extra.a: Per kg: USD 15 to the Gulf, USD 20 to the Middle East and North Africa, USD 21 to Asia Pacific and USD 25 to Europe, on flights Oman Air operates (read 27 Nov 2026).

faq_extra.q: Can I take my pet on Oman Air?
faq_extra.a: Only in the hold or as cargo, not in the cabin. From India to the Gulf a small kennel costs USD 150, a medium one USD 250 and a large one USD 438.

gulf_compare.power: Cabin only; no use on board

airlines.name: Gulf Air

cabin.summary: One cabin bag up to 6 kg
cabin.detail: Economy passengers may carry one bag or briefcase up to 6 kg and 45 x 40 x 30 cm, according to the baggage calculator on gulfair.com (re-read on 28 Nov 2026 for Bahrain to Delhi). That's lighter and shorter than most airlines allow, so many 55 cm trolleys won't qualify. Gulf Air says cabin bags are weighed and labelled at check-in.

personal.summary: Free extras on top: a handbag or purse, a laptop, a coat or blanket, an umbrella, a small camera, reading matter and infant food for the flight

checkin.allowance: Not sold on India flights; on the few Gulf routes that have it (between Bahrain and Abu Dhabi or Riyadh, and from Jeddah to Bahrain), checked bags must be bought and the cabin bag is 7 kg
30 kg on Bahrain–India flights, in up to 5 bags
35 kg on Bahrain–India flights
40 kg on Bahrain–India flights

airlines.checkin_summary: 30 kg on Light, 35 kg on Smart and 40 kg on Flex between India and Bahrain
airlines.checkin_note: These India allowances, from Gulf Air's baggage calculator, cover flights between Bahrain and Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Thiruvananthapuram, Goa and Kochi in both directions. Gulf Air also sells a Basic economy fare; check its allowance in the calculator before you book. You can split your allowance into up to 5 bags, but no bag may weigh more than 32 kg or measure more than 158 cm (76 x 51 x 31 cm). A bag over 32 kg must be repacked at the counter.
airlines.infant: An infant under 2 gets one checked piece up to 10 kg, a free folding stroller and infant car seat, and one cabin bag up to 3 kg and 44 x 35 x 20 cm. Children from 2 years get the adult allowance plus a free stroller and car seat.
notes: Gulf Air doesn't accept odd-shaped bags, bags wrapped in blankets or cloth, round bags without a flat side, woven sacks or plastic bags, or bags with long loose straps. Suitcases and cardboard boxes within 76 x 51 x 31 cm are fine, and can be plastic-wrapped at the airport.
Power banks: up to two, each up to 100 Wh. Don't charge them from the seat or use them to charge other devices during the flight.
Smart bags: the battery must be removable. Take it out and carry it in the cabin if the bag is checked in. A smart bag with a fixed battery can't fly on Gulf Air at all.

Zamzam water: eligible Umrah and Hajj pilgrims leaving any Saudi airport may check in one sealed 5 litre pack free, on top of the allowance, bought from an authorised Zamzam outlet and checked in separately.
TVs up to 50 inches can be checked in if pre-packed; larger ones go as cargo.
Pets: Gulf Air's conditions of carriage don't accept live animals or birds as checked baggage, except falcons on some routes (in the cabin or the hold) and service dogs.
Falconflyer members get one extra bag: Silver up to 10 kg, Gold 15 kg and Black 25 kg.
airlines.seo_title: Gulf Air baggage allowance from India: 6 kg cabin, 30-40 kg checked

excess.summary: Prepay extra baggage on gulfair.com, the Gulf Air app, a Gulf Air office or the contact centre, in steps of 5 kg; the prepaid rates are not offered at the airport, where standard excess rates apply
points: India is in Gulf Air's excess baggage Zone 2 (Middle East, Africa and Indian Subcontinent), with Bahrain and the Gulf in Zone 1 and Europe and the Far East in Zone 3. The price shows when you add bags in Manage booking.
Bahrain to Delhi in Economy: prepaid extra baggage costs USD 10.08 a kg if you buy it more than 24 hours before the flight and USD 16.80 a kg within 24 hours (calculator, 28 Nov 2026).

Prepaid extra baggage can be changed up to 24 hours before departure, can be used on another flight if you change your trip, and is valid for one year. It can't be moved to another passenger or refunded if you cancel yourself.
Falconflyer members can pay for extra baggage with miles, also in 5 kg steps.
Online you can add up to 50 kg (or up to 99 pieces on piece routes); for more, Gulf Air sends you to its cargo team.

sections.h: How Gulf Air differs from other Gulf airlines
items: Its cabin bag limit is the strictest: 6 kg and 45 x 40 x 30 cm, against 7 kg on the other Gulf airlines and Emirates 55 x 38 x 22 cm, Etihad 56 x 36 x 23 cm, Qatar Airways 50 x 37 x 25 cm and flydubai 55 x 38 x 20 cm.
Its India checked allowances are generous: 30 kg even on the Light fare, against 20 kg on Oman Air Super Saver and Qatar Airways Economy Lite.
It gives every infant a 3 kg cabin bag of its own; Qatar Airways gives infants none.
Like Saudia and Qatar Airways, it allows two power banks.

sections.h: Gulf Air flights to the USA
items: Flights between Bahrain and New York (JFK) use the piece concept: 2 bags of 23 kg each in Economy, 2 of 32 kg in Falcon Gold (business).
In Economy, both bags together may add up to 273 cm (length + width + height). An infant gets one 15 kg checked bag on US flights.
An extra 23 kg bag between India (Zone 2) and New York costs USD 176 if bought more than 24 hours ahead and USD 220 within 24 hours. A bag of 23 to 32 kg pays USD 60 more.

sections.h: Sports, medical equipment and lost bags
items: Gulf Air accepts bicycles, golf clubs, diving gear, surfboards, skis, fishing gear, instruments and more. Each item over 158 cm pays special baggage charges.
For CPAP or portable oxygen machines, tell Gulf Air reservations at least 48 hours before the flight and get medical clearance.

If a bag is delayed or lost, report it at the baggage claim area before you leave, then follow it with Check Delayed Bag Status on gulfair.com. Claims go on Gulf Air's claim form to the nearest Gulf Air office.
Gulf Air isn't liable for scratches, small dents or damage to wheels, straps and handles. You can declare a higher value at check-in for a fee.

faq_extra.q: What is the Gulf Air baggage allowance from India in economy?
faq_extra.a: One 6 kg cabin bag of 45 x 40 x 30 cm, plus personal items. Checked baggage between India and Bahrain is 30 kg on Light, 35 kg on Smart and 40 kg on Flex, in up to 5 bags of at most 32 kg each.

faq_extra.q: Does Gulf Air give 40 kg baggage?
faq_extra.a: Yes, on the Economy Flex fare between Bahrain and the main Indian airports. Light gives 30 kg and Smart 35 kg.

faq_extra.q: What is the Gulf Air cabin baggage size?
faq_extra.a: 45 x 40 x 30 cm and 6 kg in Economy. An infant gets a 3 kg cabin bag of 44 x 35 x 20 cm.

faq_extra.q: Can I buy extra baggage on Gulf Air at the airport?

Sports equipment counts as one of your normal pieces.

sections.h: How Kuwait Airways differs from other Gulf airlines
items: It's the only Gulf airline on our list that still counts pieces on India flights: 2 x 23 kg in Economy. Emirates, Qatar Airways, Etihad, Oman Air and Gulf Air count total weight.
Its 56 x 46 x 25 cm cabin bag is the largest economy limit among them; Saudia's 56 x 45 x 25 cm is close. Qatar Airways allows only 50 x 37 x 25 cm.
Two 23 kg bags is 46 kg in all, more than most Gulf economy fares, but each bag must stay under 23 kg. Weigh each bag on its own.
Watch for the Zero Bag fare: it's often the cheapest price shown and has no checked bag on India routes.
Platinum members in Economy get one extra 32 kg piece, or 9 kg overweight allowed on up to 2 pieces (not both).
Gold members in Economy get one extra 23 kg piece, or the same 9 kg waiver on up to 2 pieces.
Silver members get one extra 23 kg piece in every cabin.
No pets in the cabin. Pets in the hold are charged as excess baggage: KWD 40 from Kuwait to India.
Since 1 Sep 2023, Kuwait Airways carries no live animals on flights that only transit Kuwait, as cargo or baggage. So you can't fly a pet from India to Europe through Kuwait.
In India, counters open 4 hours before departure in Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kochi and Ahmedabad, 3.5 hours before in Delhi and 3 hours before in Chennai. They close 1 hour before.
In Kuwait (Terminal 4), counters open 4 hours before and close 90 minutes before flights to India and Europe.
Online check-in opens 24 hours before departure. If you change planes in Kuwait, collect the onward boarding pass from the transfer desk.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged

faq_extra.q: What is the Kuwait Airways baggage allowance in economy class?

faq_extra.q: What does 1 pc or 2 pc mean on a Kuwait Airways ticket?

faq_extra.q: What is the Kuwait Airways cabin baggage size?

faq_extra.q: What are Kuwait Airways excess baggage charges from Kuwait to India?
faq_extra.a: KWD 40 for an extra piece at the airport, or KWD 34 if you prepay online at least 24 hours before. An overweight or oversize bag costs KWD 16, or KWD 32 if it's both.

faq_extra.q: How do I track my Kuwait Airways baggage?

sections.h: How Singapore Airlines differs from other airlines from India
items: Economy Lite still includes 25 kg checked. Qatar Airways Lite gives 20 kg, and IndiGo's Lite gives none.

Excess baggage is priced in US dollars per kg and gets cheaper the earlier you buy. There are no rupee rates on its India site.
Elite members get more: PPS Club doubles the allowance, KrisFlyer Elite Gold adds 20 kg and Elite Silver 10 kg, on flights run by Singapore Airlines.
Sports gear counts in your normal allowance, up to 32 kg and 315 x 75 x 80 cm. Call 5 working days ahead if it's over 240 cm. Bikes go in a case with tyres let down; e-bikes aren't allowed.

Counters open 4 hours before departure in Delhi, Mumbai (Terminal 2) and Ahmedabad; 3 h 30 min in Bengaluru and Hyderabad; 3 h 25 min in Kolkata; 3 hours in Chennai and Kochi. All close 1 hour before.

A first flight on Scoot from India that connects to Singapore Airlines in Singapore can be checked in online through Singapore Airlines.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed or damaged

faq_extra.q: What is the Singapore Airlines baggage allowance from India?

faq_extra.q: Is Singapore Airlines baggage allowance 30 kg?

faq_extra.q: What is the Singapore Airlines baggage allowance from India to Australia?

faq_extra.q: What is the Singapore Airlines cabin baggage size?
faq_extra.a: One 7 kg bag whose length, width and height add up to 115 cm or less in Economy, plus one item up to 40 x 30 x 10 cm.

faq_extra.q: How much do Singapore Airlines charge for extra baggage from India?
faq_extra.a: USD 20 a kg between India and Singapore at the full rate, and more to farther places. Buy in Manage Booking 48 hours or more ahead for 25% off.

airlines.carry_note: Singapore Airlines keeps [power banks](can-i-carry/power-bank.html) in the seat pocket or under the seat, never in the overhead bin. sections.h: How Thai Airways differs from other airlines from India
items: Thai counts bags, not kilos: 1 bag of 23 kg on Saver and Standard, 2 on Flexi and Full Flex. A 30 kg bag is charged as overweight, even on a fare with two bags.

Its cabin bag may be 56 x 45 x 25 cm, wider than IndiGo's 55 x 35 x 25 cm or Air India's 55 x 40 x 20 cm. Thai also limits cabin bags to about 115 cm in total, so a full-size 56 x 45 x 25 cm bag (126 cm) risks being questioned.
Extra bags are priced in US dollars per bag and are cheaper if you buy them at least 24 hours before the flight.
Thai doesn't carry pets in the cabin, like Singapore Airlines; Air India and Etihad take small cats and dogs in the cabin.
Sports gear counts as one bag in your allowance, up to 32 kg and 330 cm. One golf set (bag, clubs, balls and one pair of shoes) is included free.

Bikes and cricket or hockey kits pay one unit (USD 80 on international flights) if they are oversize or weigh 23 to 32 kg, or for each extra piece. Pack bikes and other gear properly, or Thai may refuse them.
Ask Thai at least 3 working days before the flight and reach the counter at least 2 hours early. Sports and special baggage fees aren't refunded.
One portable musical instrument up to 100 cm long counts in your allowance. A cello or other fragile instrument can fly on a seat you buy, booked at least 2 days ahead.
Pets aren't allowed in the cabin. Only guide dogs for blind passengers and hearing dogs for deaf passengers fly in the cabin, free; tell Thai at least 48 hours before.
Cats and dogs can travel in the hold as checked baggage (AVIH), charged at a flat rate and not counted in your allowance. Ask your local Thai office about the box. Snub-nosed breeds are refused.
Pets in the hold aren't carried to Auckland, Denpasar (Bali), Dubai or Hong Kong, to or from Australian cities, or on A320 flights.

Counters open 3 hours before departure in Delhi, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Hyderabad and Kochi, 3 h 30 min in Chennai and 4 hours in Mumbai. They close 1 hour before departure at all of these and in Ahmedabad.
Mobile check-in opens 24 hours before the flight. Drop your bags at least 60 minutes before, and be at the gate early: it closes 10 minutes before departure.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged
items: Tell Thai's ground staff at the airport before you leave. You get a copy of your report and a file reference number, and can follow the bag online.

If your bag is more than 24 hours late, Thai pays reasonable costs for essentials, up to USD 100 per person on international routes. Keep the receipts and claim in writing within 21 days of getting the bag.
Report a damaged bag at the airport and get a Property Irregularity Report (PIR). Claim in writing within 7 days of arrival. Thai's liability is limited to 1,288 SDR per passenger.
Lost and found in Mumbai: 1800 102 1226 or customer.bom@thaiairways.com (from Thai's airport page).

faq_extra.q: What is the Thai Airways baggage allowance from India to Bangkok?
faq_extra.a: In economy: 1 bag of up to 23 kg on Saver and Standard fares, 2 bags of 23 kg each on Flexi and Full Flex. You also get one 7 kg cabin bag and a small personal item.

faq_extra.q: What is the Thai Airways cabin baggage size?
faq_extra.a: One bag up to 7 kg and 56 x 45 x 25 cm, wheels and handles included. Thai also says about 115 cm in total, so a slightly smaller bag is safer. A laptop or handbag up to 37.5 x 25 x 12.5 cm and 1.5 kg goes free.

faq_extra.q: Can I check in 2 bags with Thai Airways?
faq_extra.a: Yes, on Economy Flexi and Full Flex fares, each up to 23 kg. On Saver and Standard you can buy a second bag: from India to Bangkok it costs USD 95 at least 24 hours ahead, or USD 115 at the airport.

faq_extra.q: What is the Thai Airways baggage allowance from India to Australia?
faq_extra.a: The same piece rules apply through Bangkok: 1 or 2 bags of 23 kg in economy, by fare. An extra bag from India to Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane costs USD 205 if bought 24 hours ahead.

faq_extra.q: How do I add extra baggage on Thai Airways?
faq_extra.a: Buy it online, through Thai's call centre or office, or from your travel agent at least 24 hours before the flight. Later than that, the airport price applies.

airlines.carry_note: Thai doesn't let you use a [power bank](can-i-carry/power-bank.html) on board. Liquids in your cabin bag follow the 100 ml rule (see [liquids](can-i-carry/liquids.html)). Flying to Thailand? Our [Thailand trip guide](../trips/thailand-trip-from-india.html) covers what to pack.

sections.h: Sports equipment, big bags and musical instruments

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged

faq_extra.q: What is the Vietjet baggage allowance from India to Vietnam?

faq_extra.q: What is the Vietjet cabin baggage size?

faq_extra.q: Does Vietjet include checked baggage?

faq_extra.q: How much is Vietjet extra baggage from India?

points: Excess baggage is charged per kg by distance zone, from where you start to your final destination. India is in Zone 3: USD 18 per kg to Malaysia, USD 37 to Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia or China, USD 36 to Japan or Korea, USD 48 to Australia or New Zealand and USD 54 to the UK or Europe.
On routes to the Americas or Africa, Malaysia Airlines counts pieces: an extra economy bag (up to 23 kg) costs USD 280, and a bag of 23 to 32 kg costs USD 83 more.
You can buy extra baggage in advance in Manage My Booking or through the call centre, up to 24 hours before take-off. Malaysia Airlines recommends buying ahead but doesn't publish its prepaid prices.
Extra baggage is non-refundable and works only on flights operated by Malaysia Airlines, not codeshare or MASwings flights. Unused kilos are lost, not refunded.
If your bags still weigh more than your allowance plus what you bought, the counter charges the normal excess rate for the rest.

notes: Power banks: up to two, in your cabin bag only, each in its own pouch. Using or charging them is banned for the whole flight, and they must stay with you (under the seat or in the seat pocket, not in the overhead bin). Up to 100 Wh is fine; 100 to 160 Wh needs airline approval; over 160 Wh is banned.
Smart bags and rideable suitcases have had extra restrictions since 15 November 2024: check Malaysia Airlines' smart baggage page before you fly with one.
Fresh or frozen seafood can't be checked in. It may go in the cabin only, properly packed without crushed ice, and subject to your destination's quarantine rules.
Cash, jewellery, electronics, passports and other valuables aren't allowed in checked baggage.

sections.h: How Malaysia Airlines differs from other airlines from India
items: It counts kilos on India routes: 20 kg on Value, 25 kg on Basic, 35 kg on Flex. You can split them over as many bags as you like, as long as no bag is over 32 kg.
The personal item counts inside the 7 kg cabin limit. Air Arabia and Thai Airways allow a small bag on top.
Its cabin bag is 56 x 36 x 23 cm, a little narrower than Air India's 40 cm.
Excess weight costs USD 18 a kg from India to Malaysia, but USD 37 a kg once your trip carries on to Singapore, Thailand or Vietnam.
Enrich Platinum members get double the free allowance (and 15 kg extra for golf), Gold members 50% more and Silver members 10 kg more.
oneworld Emerald members get 20 kg (or one bag) more and Sapphire members 15 kg (or one bag) more. These extras apply only to checked baggage, not the cabin bag.

Golf sets, surfboards, non-motorised bikes, fishing gear, diving and ski gear and similar items are accepted if packed in protective materials. Malaysia Airlines publishes no separate sports fee; a bag over 158 cm or 32 kg counts as oversized and may cost extra.
Small instruments such as flutes or violins can be your cabin bag. A cello or guitar can fly on an extra seat you buy; sturdier large instruments go as checked baggage.
Malaysia Airlines' India website doesn't publish a pets rule on its baggage pages. Ask the airline or MASkargo before you book, and check your destination's import rules.
Web and mobile check-in are open from 48 hours to 90 minutes before the flight.

Airport counters close 60 minutes before departure, and bag drop closes at the same time. The gate closes 30 minutes before take-off. Malaysia Airlines asks you to reach the airport 3 hours before an international flight and lists no separate times for Indian airports.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged
items: Report it at the Baggage Office before you leave the airport, or later on Malaysia Airlines' Self-Service Baggage Reporting Portal. Keep the reference number you get.
Most delayed bags are found within 24 hours and delivered to your home, office or hotel where customs allow.
Report a damaged bag within 7 days of receiving it. If your last flight wasn't run by Malaysia Airlines, report to that airline instead.

faq_extra.q: What is the Malaysia Airlines baggage allowance from India?
faq_extra.a: In economy: 20 kg checked on Value, 25 kg on Basic and 35 kg on Flex, plus one 7 kg cabin bag that includes your personal item. Business gets 40 to 55 kg.

faq_extra.q: What is the Malaysia Airlines cabin baggage size?
faq_extra.a: Up to 56 x 36 x 23 cm (115 cm in total) for the overhead bin, and 25 x 36 x 25 cm for a personal item under the seat. Both together must weigh 7 kg or less in economy.

faq_extra.q: Can I carry a laptop bag on Malaysia Airlines?
faq_extra.a: Yes, one laptop bag, handbag, briefcase or small camera bag besides your cabin bag, but it counts within the same 7 kg in economy.

faq_extra.q: How much is Malaysia Airlines extra baggage from India to Australia?
faq_extra.a: USD 48 per kg at the normal excess rate from India (Zone 3) to Australia or New Zealand. Buying extra baggage in Manage My Booking at least 24 hours ahead is recommended, but the prepaid price is only shown when you book.

faq_extra.q: How strict is Malaysia Airlines with cabin baggage?
faq_extra.a: The limit is 7 kg in economy, personal item included, and bags must fit the overhead bin size of 56 x 36 x 23 cm. Weigh your bags at home so you aren't asked to check one in.

airlines.carry_note: Malaysia Airlines keeps [power banks](can-i-carry/power-bank.html) out of the overhead bin and bans using them on board. Fresh or frozen seafood may travel only in the cabin. Going to Malaysia? Our [Malaysia trip guide](../trips/malaysia-trip-from-india.html) and [Malaysia packing list](../guides/malaysia-packing-list.html) cover what to take.

AirAsia says pre-booking saves up to 80% against airport counter prices; the price for your route is shown when you book. airlines.infant: Infants under 2 get no cabin baggage allowance on AirAsia. Children aged 2 and over get the same 7 kg as adults. A stroller or pram used by your child travels free as checked baggage; a foldable stroller can go in the cabin if it fits the cabin size and weight rules.

Smart bags: a non-removable battery must be no more than 2.7 Wh (lithium-ion) or 0.3 g (lithium metal). A removable battery must come out and travel in the cabin.
Carry a doctor's letter with prescription medicines, and pack syringes or injectables professionally and labelled for security.

faq_extra.q: Can I buy extra cabin baggage at the airport on AirAsia?
faq_extra.a: Only up to 3 kg, for a 10 kg maximum. Since 13 April 2026 Xtra Carry-On, which takes you to 14 kg, must be pre-booked on the AirAsia MOVE app or website up to 2 hours before departure.

faq_extra.q: Is a laptop bag allowed on AirAsia besides the cabin bag?
faq_extra.a: Yes. One small item such as a laptop bag or handbag, up to 40 x 30 x 10 cm, is allowed with your main cabin bag, but both must weigh 7 kg or less together.

faq_extra.q: What is the AirAsia cabin baggage size?
faq_extra.a: One bag up to 56 x 36 x 23 cm plus one small item up to 40 x 30 x 10 cm, 7 kg in total. With Xtra Carry-On you get 14 kg, no bag over 10 kg.

faq_extra.q: What is the AirAsia baggage price from India to Malaysia?
faq_extra.a: AirAsia shows the price for your route when you book or add baggage in the AirAsia MOVE app. It doesn't publish a fixed rate, but says pre-booking saves up to 80% against the airport counter.

faq_extra.q: Is AirAsia India the same as AirAsia?
faq_extra.a: No. AirAsia India was merged into Air India Express, which now flies its old routes in India. AirAsia's own flights from India go to Kuala Lumpur and Bangkok.

points: Buy checked baggage with your booking or later in the AirAsia MOVE app or website, up to 2 hours before the flight. At an airport counter you get the pre-book price only if you buy at least 4 hours before departure.
You can buy up to 60 kg per person per flight; the 50 and 60 kg options are limited.
Xtra Carry-On (7 kg more in the cabin, 14 kg in total) must be bought online up to 2 hours before departure. At the airport you can add only 3 kg, for 10 kg at most.

sections.h: How AirAsia differs from other airlines from India
items: The Low Fare includes no checked bag, only 7 kg in the cabin for two pieces together. Malaysia Airlines includes at least 20 kg on every fare from India.
AirAsia sells checked baggage by weight in one allowance per flight, up to 60 kg. Buy it before you reach the airport.
You can't use or charge a power bank on any AirAsia flight.
AirAsia doesn't carry pets at all.
AirAsia India no longer exists as a separate airline: it was merged into Air India Express, which has its own baggage rules.

Golf sets, surfboards (up to 277 cm), non-motorised bikes, skis and snowboards, and diving gear with a tank need a Sports Equipment Allowance. It is sold in 20, 25, 30 and 40 kg, one per person per way, and can't be combined with your normal checked baggage.
Buy it online up to 2 hours before the flight. At the airport you pay the pre-book price only if you buy at least 4 hours before departure. It isn't refundable.
Bikes must be packed in a bike bag, box or plastic wrap with the handlebars turned, pedals off and tyres let down. No item may weigh over 32 kg.
Other sports items, such as a cricket kit, can go in your normal checked baggage.
AirAsia's policy is that it doesn't accept any pets or animals on its flights.
Check in online or in the AirAsia MOVE app; you must use the counter if you fly with an infant 8 days old or younger, need special help or are under 16 and travelling alone.
For international flights, counters and self bag drop open 3 hours before departure (4 hours on long-haul flights) and close 1 hour before. AirAsia doesn't list separate times for Indian airports.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged
items: If your bag doesn't come out, tell an AirAsia guest service officer at once, with your booking number or bag tag. You fill in a Property Irregularity Report (PIR) and get a PIR number.
A found bag is delivered to the address on the PIR. To claim for a delay, write to AirAsia within 21 days of getting the bag back.
A bag still missing 14 days after the PIR (international flights) is declared lost, and AirAsia's Central Baggage Tracing Office contacts you.
Report a damaged bag before you leave the airport. AirAsia may pay less if the damage came from over-packing or poor packing.

airlines.carry_note: AirAsia bans using or charging a [power bank](can-i-carry/power-bank.html) on board. Looking for the old AirAsia India? See [Air India Express](air-india-express.html). Liquids in your cabin bag follow the 100 ml rule (see [liquids](can-i-carry/liquids.html)). Flying to Malaysia or Thailand? See our [Malaysia trip guide](../trips/malaysia-trip-from-india.html) and [Thailand trip guide](../trips/thailand-trip-from-india.html).

points: Bought with your ticket, to or from Delhi or Mumbai: MYR 90 for 10 kg, 140 for 20 kg, 230 for 30 kg and 280 for 40 kg.

sections.h: How Batik Air differs from other airlines from India
items: Super Saver includes no checked bag. Economy Flexi gives 30 kg on India routes, more than the 25 kg it gives on most other international routes.
Pre-bought baggage is cheapest with your first booking. Bought later, 20 kg from Delhi or Mumbai costs MYR 440 instead of MYR 140.
Power banks must stay on your person, not in any bag. Most airlines let you keep them in your cabin bag.
Besides the 7 kg cabin bag and personal item, you may carry a small ladies' handbag or men's pouch and one duty-free bag.

Diving gear, bowling balls, golf bags, bikes and surfboards count within your normal checked allowance. You sign a Limited Release Tag, so Batik Air isn't liable for damage; travel insurance is a good idea.
A second surfboard pays an RM 65 handling charge, and surfboards aren't carried on ATR (propeller) routes. A bike bag may be up to 165 cm long, and at most 10 bikes fit on one flight.
Not accepted: hang gliders, sails, kayaks, canoes and oars, pole vaults and javelins.
Small instruments such as a guitar or violin can be your cabin bag. A cello up to 165 cm and 75 kg can fly on an extra seat bought at a ticket office.
Batik Air's baggage page and FAQ don't publish a pets rule. Ask Batik Air before you book if you need to fly with an animal.
Batik Air asks you to check in 3 hours before an international flight at Kuala Lumpur. Kiosks there take check-in up to 75 minutes before departure.
Batik Air doesn't publish counter closing times for Indian airports. Reach the airport 3 hours early, as for any international flight from India.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged

Batik Air sells an optional Delayed Baggage Service with Blue Ribbon. If you bought it, file your report with Blue Ribbon through the link on Batik Air's baggage page.

faq_extra.q: What is the Batik Air baggage allowance from India?
faq_extra.a: Super Saver: no checked bag. Economy Value: 20 kg. Economy Flexi: 30 kg. Every economy fare includes one 7 kg cabin bag with a personal item.

faq_extra.q: What is the Batik Air cabin baggage size?
faq_extra.a: 56 x 36 x 23 cm (115 cm in total). The cabin bag and personal item together may weigh 7 kg in economy; extra weight at the gate costs RM 50 per kg.

faq_extra.q: How much does Batik Air charge to add baggage from India?
faq_extra.a: With your first booking, 20 kg to or from Delhi or Mumbai costs MYR 140, Kochi or Tiruchirappalli MYR 160 and Bengaluru MYR 170. Added later it costs MYR 330 to 440. At the airport from India it's INR 1,000 per kg.

faq_extra.q: Can I add baggage on Batik Air after booking?
faq_extra.a: Yes, in Manage Booking or through the Customer Care Centre, up to 12 hours before departure and before you check in online. It costs more than buying it with the ticket.

airlines.carry_note: Batik Air wants [power banks](can-i-carry/power-bank.html) carried on your person, not in a bag. Seafood and frozen meat travel only in the cabin. Going to Malaysia? Our [Malaysia trip guide](../trips/malaysia-trip-from-india.html) covers what to pack.

airlines.checkin_note: Cathay counts bags (pieces), not total kilos. Each bag may weigh up to 23 kg in Economy and Premium Economy (32 kg in Business) and measure up to 158 cm in total (length + width + height). Cathay's baggage calculator, read on 28 Nov 2026, gave the same allowance from Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai and Hyderabad to Hong Kong, and from India to New York, Vancouver, London, Tokyo and Shanghai.
