excess.summary: From India an extra bag costs USD 130 to Hong Kong and USD 230 to the USA or Canada, paid at the airport, because Cathay's prepaid and online extra baggage isn't sold for journeys to or from India
points: India is in Cathay's Zone 2. From India, one extra bag (up to 23 kg and 158 cm) costs USD 130 to Hong Kong, USD 150 to mainland China, Taiwan, Japan, South Korea or South-East Asia (Zone 1), USD 170 to the Middle East or South Asia (Zone 2/3), USD 200 to Australia, New Zealand, the UK, Europe or South Africa (Zone 4) and USD 230 to the USA, Canada, Mexico or South America (Zone 5/6).

A bag of 23 to 32 kg pays an overweight charge: USD 100 from India to Hong Kong, Asia or the Middle East, and USD 150 to Zone 4 (Europe, UK, Australia) or Zone 5/6 (Americas). This heavy bag charge is paid only at the airport, not online.

A bag of 158 to 203 cm in total pays USD 200. A bag over 32 kg or 203 cm costs four times the extra bag charge and needs approval from Customer Care at least three working days before you fly; otherwise it must be repacked.

Fees are collected in local currency, and tax is added. Prepaid extra baggage (up to 10% off) and online Regular Extra Baggage are both listed as unavailable for journeys to or from India. Miles Plus Cash can't be used at airports in India and Nepal.

notes: Power banks: at most two per passenger, each under 100 Wh, in your cabin bag only. You can't use them to charge devices or recharge them from the seat power at any time during the flight. They must stay in your bag under the seat in front, never in the overhead bin or checked bags. Extra power banks are taken away at Hong Kong airport security.

Spare batteries: up to 20 spare batteries under 100 Wh in cabin baggage, protected against short circuit; 2 spares of 100 to 160 Wh. No spare batteries of any kind (lithium, alkaline or dry cell) in checked bags. Batteries with no clear Wh marking are refused.
Smart bags with a battery that can't be removed are refused in the cabin and in the hold. Hoverboards and other self-balancing scooters are banned.

Liquids: 100 ml per container in one clear, resealable 1-litre bag (about 20 x 20 cm) per passenger. Medicines, baby food and breast milk may be more, after a security check. Powders over 350 ml face limits on flights to the USA, Australia and New Zealand.
Nail scissors, letter knives and other sharp, pointed items must go in checked baggage.
Religious idols can fly on a seat you buy, in Economy only, up to 60 x 36 x 36 cm and under 15 kg. Book by phone with Cathay at least 3 working days before the flight.

sections.h: How Cathay Pacific differs from other airlines from India
items: Cathay counts bags, not kilos, on every route from India, even to Hong Kong and South-East Asia. Light gives 1 bag of 23 kg and Essential and Flex give 2 bags, so Essential can carry up to 46 kg in two bags.
The 7 kg cabin limit covers your cabin bag and your small item together. Air India allows 7 kg for the cabin bag plus a separate personal item.
Power banks must stay under the seat in front and can't be used at all on board, not even to charge a phone. Use the seat power instead.
Extra baggage from India can't be prepaid at a discount. You pay the zone price at the airport.
Pets travel only as cargo through Cathay Cargo, not in the cabin. Only guide and assistance dogs fly with you.

sections.h: Cathay Pacific baggage from India to the USA, Canada and the UK
items: All flights from India to North America and the UK connect in Hong Kong. Cathay's calculator gives the same piece allowance as to Hong Kong: 1 bag of 23 kg on Light, 2 bags of 23 kg on Essential, Flex and Premium Economy, and 2 bags of 32 kg in Business.
On a single ticket your bags are checked through to your final city. If you fly on to a domestic flight inside the USA, you may need to collect your bags and clear customs first.
For a trip that starts or ends in the USA or Canada, the baggage rules chosen at the start of the ticket apply to the whole journey, even with stopovers.
An extra bag from India costs USD 230 to the USA or Canada and USD 200 to the UK, plus USD 150 if it weighs 23 to 32 kg.

Sports equipment (golf, hockey, fishing, skiing, surfing, climbing and similar) counts as one bag in your free allowance. Normal weight limits apply, and an item may be at most 203 cm long. Extra pieces pay the normal extra bag charge.
A bicycle must be non-motorised, in a hard case or bike box, with pedals removed or fixed and tyres deflated. Tell Customer Care at least 72 hours before departure, because space is limited.

Small instruments such as a violin or flute can be your cabin bag, up to 7 kg and 93 x 39 x 24 cm in a hard case. Bigger ones are checked in, or fly on a seat you buy (up to 136 x 48 x 44 cm and 32 kg), booked with Customer Care at least three working days ahead.

Cathay's pet page describes pet travel only as cargo with Cathay Cargo (Cathay Live Animal). Since 1 September 2025 Cathay Cargo takes pet bookings only from IPATA or ATA members, IATA freight forwarders or holders of an IATA Live Animals certificate, so use a pet travel agent. Guide and assistance dogs can fly in the cabin.
Delhi (Terminal 3), Mumbai (Terminal 2), Bengaluru (Terminal 2) and Hyderabad: Cathay's counters open 4 hours (240 minutes) before departure.
Chennai (Terminal 2, new international terminal): counters open 3.5 hours (210 minutes) before departure.
At all five airports the counters close exactly 60 minutes before departure. Arrive early enough to finish check-in, immigration and security.
Mumbai and Bengaluru also have self-service check-in kiosks.

With a single ticket on Cathay flights, your bags are checked through to your final destination. If you already have your onward boarding pass, follow the transfer signs to Departures (Level 6). If not, go to Cathay's Transfer Desk in area W1.

You go through security screening again before your next flight. Liquids must follow the 100 ml rule at Hong Kong transfer security. Duty-free liquids in a sealed bag get extra screening and may be taken out and resealed in a new bag, so allow extra time.
Cathay asks you to be at the gate at least 35 minutes before departure. Gates close 15 minutes before departure.
A minimum connection time for Hong Kong isn't published on the Cathay or Hong Kong airport pages we read.
Hong Kong airport allows at most two power banks per departing passenger, in hand baggage only. Extra ones are taken away at security.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed or damaged
items: Report a delayed bag at the baggage service counter near the belts in the arrival hall, before customs. Keep the report reference number and follow your bag on Cathay's WorldTracer page.

Report damage at the same counter, or by phone to your local Cathay baggage office within 7 days of getting your bag. Cathay doesn't pay for normal wear such as scratches, dents, or broken wheels, zips, locks or handles.
If the airport team can't solve it, fill in Cathay's online baggage claim form and send your receipts after you get the confirmation email.

Under the Montreal Convention the limit is 1,519 Special Drawing Rights per passenger. Cathay isn't liable for cash, jewellery, cameras, medicines, keys, documents or fragile items packed in checked bags.

faq_extra.q: What is the Cathay Pacific baggage allowance from India to Hong Kong?
faq_extra.a: Economy Light includes 1 checked bag of 23 kg, and Essential and Flex include 2 bags of 23 kg each. Every Economy fare also has a cabin bag and a small item, 7 kg in total.

faq_extra.q: What is the Cathay Pacific baggage allowance from India to the USA?
faq_extra.a: The same as to Hong Kong: 1 bag of 23 kg on Light and 2 bags of 23 kg on Essential and Flex. Premium Economy gets 2 bags of 23 kg and Business 2 bags of 32 kg. Each bag may measure up to 158 cm in total.

faq_extra.q: What is the Cathay Pacific cabin baggage size and weight?
faq_extra.a: The cabin bag may be up to 56 x 36 x 23 cm and the small item up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm. In Economy and Premium Economy both together may weigh 7 kg; in Business 10 kg.

faq_extra.q: What is the Cathay Pacific maximum baggage weight?
faq_extra.a: Each free bag may weigh 23 kg in Economy and Premium Economy and 32 kg in Business. A bag of 23 to 32 kg pays an overweight charge at the airport. A bag over 32 kg needs approval at least three working days before you fly.

faq_extra.q: What are Cathay Pacific extra baggage charges from India?
faq_extra.a: An extra bag from India costs USD 130 to Hong Kong, USD 150 to Japan, China or South-East Asia, USD 200 to the UK or Europe and USD 230 to the USA or Canada, plus tax. You pay at the airport, because prepaid extra baggage isn't sold for journeys to or from India.

faq_extra.q: Is Cathay Pacific strict with baggage allowance?
faq_extra.a: Cathay's rules are clear: bags over 32 kg or 203 cm aren't accepted without approval and must otherwise be repacked, and the 7 kg cabin limit covers both cabin items. Cabin crew won't lift bags for you, so weigh your bags at home.

faq_extra.q: How do I track delayed Cathay Pacific baggage?
faq_extra.a: Make a report at the baggage service counter in the arrival hall before customs, and keep the reference number. You can then follow your bag on Cathay's WorldTracer tracking page.

For [spices and masala](can-i-carry/spices-and-masala.html), remember the 350 ml powder limit in the cabin on flights to the USA, and see [sweets and home food](can-i-carry/sweets-and-home-food.html) before you pack food.

airlines.checkin_summary: None on Economy Light, 1 bag of 23 kg on other Economy fares, 2 bags in Premium Economy
airlines.checkin_note: These are Lufthansa's allowances for intercontinental flights, which include all flights between India and Germany, the rest of Europe, the USA and Canada. Lufthansa counts pieces, not total kilos. Each Economy or Premium Economy bag can weigh up to 23 kg and measure up to 158 cm (length + width + height). A heavier or bigger bag is excess baggage, and nothing over 32 kg is taken as baggage. Lufthansa's baggage page lists only "Economy Class" next to Economy Light, and doesn't name other fares such as Classic or Flex there. Your ticket or booking email shows the allowance that applies to you. If your trip mixes airlines, the rules of the airline flying the longest part usually apply.
airlines.infant: A baby under 2 gets one checked bag up to 23 kg and 158 cm, except on Light fares. Each child can also take one free item: a folding stroller, baby carriage or bicycle trailer in the hold, or a certified child seat or baby carrier in the cabin. A fully folding pocket buggy (up to 55 x 40 x 23 cm) can go in the cabin but counts as your cabin bag. Electric pushchairs are not allowed. On Economy Light, only the adult travelling with the baby can buy an extra bag. Children over 2 get the same allowance as adults.

excess.summary: Lufthansa charges flat rates per bag by distance band: an extra 23 kg bag costs EUR 120 to 220 online or EUR 160 to 260 at the check-in desk on intercontinental routes
points: Lufthansa's page has three intercontinental bands (short-, medium- and long-haul) but doesn't say which band flights from India fall into. The ranges below cover all three.
Extra standard bag (up to 23 kg and 158 cm) in Economy or Premium Economy, per route: EUR 120-140, 160-180 or 200-220 online; EUR 160, 210 or 260 at the check-in desk.
Extra bag that is over 23 kg or over 158 cm: EUR 250-255 to 400-405 online, EUR 270 to 420 at the desk. Over both: EUR 350-355 to 550-555 online, EUR 370 to 570 at the desk.
If a bag within your allowance is too heavy (23 to 32 kg) or too big (158 to 292 cm), you pay a flat EUR 100, 120 or 150; if it is both, EUR 200, 240 or 300.
Economy Light first bag: EUR 70-85 on lufthansa.com or EUR 105 at check-in, per direction (EUR 80 to and from the USA or Canada).

Fees are charged in the currency of your departure airport, and local taxes may be added. Book under My Bookings, during online check-in (up to 2 hours before departure, up to five bags), at the airport or through the Service Center. A paid bag can't be refunded on its own.

notes: Power banks: up to two per passenger, each up to 100 Wh, in your cabin bag or on you only, never in checked bags. Power banks of 100 to 160 Wh need Lufthansa's approval, which you request through its Help Center. Charging or using a power bank on board is prohibited (except with approved medical devices), and power banks must not go in the overhead locker: keep them under the seat in front, in the seat pocket or on you.

Other devices with lithium batteries (phones, laptops, cameras) up to 100 Wh: up to 15 per passenger, best in your cabin bag. Spare batteries go only in the cabin, with the terminals taped or in a pouch.
Flying into India and connecting to a domestic flight? You must collect your bags, clear customs and check them in again. The same applies on arrival in the USA or Canada.

Flying to the USA: TSA may force open locked bags, so Lufthansa suggests a TSA-approved lock. Leaving the USA, you may take only one cabin bag and one personal item through security, whatever your class.
Tag every bag with your name and mobile number, inside and out. Free tags are available at the check-in counter.

sections.h: How Lufthansa differs from other airlines from India
items: Lufthansa counts bags, not kilos: 1 bag of 23 kg on Economy, even to Europe. Gulf airlines such as Emirates and Qatar Airways give a total weight in kilos on many routes.
Economy Light includes no checked bag at all on flights from India, only an 8 kg cabin bag and a personal item.
Its cabin bag limit is 8 kg and 23 cm deep, a little more than the 7 kg and 20 cm on Air India.
Power banks: 100 Wh and no charging on board, and they can't go in the overhead locker.
Small cats and dogs (up to 8 kg with the carrier) can fly in the cabin on Lufthansa-operated flights.
Sports gear counts in your free allowance if it fits the number of bags and weight for your class. On Economy Light it is always charged. Register it at least 72 hours before departure.
Over your allowance, sports items pay a flat rate per route, for example EUR 150, 200 or 250 for a golf bag or a packed bicycle on intercontinental routes. Bicycles must be in a bike case or bag.
Lufthansa's sports list has no entry for cricket kits, so these are charged as normal excess baggage if they are over your allowance.

Pets: only cats and dogs. A pet of up to 8 kg together with its soft carrier (max. 55 x 40 x 23 cm) can travel in the cabin; heavier pets go in the air-conditioned hold. The pet must be at least 12 weeks old (15 weeks to, from or via Germany).

Register the pet at least 72 hours before departure. Each passenger may take up to two animals. You pay the fee at check-in, but Lufthansa's site doesn't publish the amount, and it doesn't say whether pets can fly in the cabin on flights from India. Check with Lufthansa and the entry rules of every country on your route.

Lufthansa's check-in deadline tool (read 28 Nov 2026) shows these closing times for check-in and bag drop: Delhi T3, Bengaluru, Chennai and Hyderabad 90 minutes before departure; Mumbai T2 (counters A5-A7) 60 minutes before departure.
The tool lists Kolkata and Pune but gives no deadline for them, so check your booking.
Online check-in opens 30 hours before departure on lufthansa.com or the Lufthansa app. You must still have your boarding pass and have dropped your bags before the deadline.
Travelling with a pet in the cabin? You must collect your boarding pass at the check-in counter.

sections.h: Changing planes in Frankfurt or Munich
items: On one ticket, your bags are usually checked through to your final airport. You don't collect them in Germany.

Frankfurt: transfer security checkpoints still use the 100 ml rule. Liquids must be in containers of up to 100 ml in one clear, resealable 1-litre bag. The 2-litre rule with new CT scanners applies only at some departure checkpoints.

Munich: if your trip started outside the EU, such as in India, your cabin liquids must already meet the 100 ml and 1-litre bag rule when you transfer. Duty-free bought in India should stay sealed in its security bag with the receipt.

Neither Frankfurt nor Munich Airport publishes a minimum connection time. Both say that on one ticket the airline plans enough time, and that separate tickets need extra time for security, passport control and re-checking bags.

Passport control: Munich Airport says that if you arrive from outside the Schengen area (such as India) and fly on outside it (such as to the USA or Canada), you usually don't pass passport control if you stay in the gate area. If you fly on to a Schengen country such as France or Italy, you do, and you may need a Schengen visa.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed or damaged
items: Report a missing bag before you leave the airport, online or at the baggage tracing desk, and keep the reference number (PIR, for example FRALH12345). You can track it online with that number and get status updates by email.
If the bag isn't found within five days, fill in the contents list on the baggage status page. A bag delayed for more than 21 days counts as lost.
You can buy essential items while you wait and claim them back within two years: clothes you can keep using are repaid at 50%, toiletries at 100%.
Damaged bag: report it straight away at the airport, or online within seven days if you notice it later. Missing items from inside a bag must also be reported in writing within seven days.
Lufthansa's liability follows the Montreal Convention, up to 1,519 SDR (about EUR 1,900) per passenger.

faq_extra.q: What is the Lufthansa baggage allowance from India to Germany?
faq_extra.a: Economy Light includes no checked bag; other Economy fares include 1 bag of 23 kg, and Premium Economy 2 bags of 23 kg. Every Economy fare also includes an 8 kg cabin bag and a personal item.

faq_extra.q: What is the Lufthansa baggage allowance from India to the USA?
faq_extra.a: The same as to Europe: no checked bag on Economy Light, 1 bag of 23 kg on other Economy fares and 2 bags of 23 kg in Premium Economy. Lufthansa's rules usually apply to the whole trip if it is the first airline on your ticket.

faq_extra.q: What is the Lufthansa cabin baggage size and weight?
faq_extra.a: One cabin bag up to 8 kg and 55 x 40 x 23 cm (about 21.6 x 15.7 x 9 inches), plus a personal item up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm. Business and First allow two 8 kg cabin bags.

faq_extra.q: What are Lufthansa extra baggage fees from India?
faq_extra.a: An extra 23 kg bag costs EUR 120 to 220 online or EUR 160 to 260 at the check-in desk on intercontinental routes, depending on distance. Lufthansa doesn't say which distance band India is in, and fees are charged in the departure country's currency.

faq_extra.q: What is the maximum size of a Lufthansa checked bag?
faq_extra.a: 158 cm in total (length + width + height) and 23 kg in Economy. Bigger or heavier bags, up to 292 cm and 32 kg, travel as excess baggage for a fee.

faq_extra.q: How do I track delayed Lufthansa baggage?
faq_extra.a: Report it online or at the airport baggage desk before you leave, and keep your reference number (PIR). You can check the status online with that number and subscribe to email updates.

faq_extra.q: How do I make a Lufthansa baggage damage claim?
faq_extra.a: Report the damage at the airport straight away, or online within seven days of getting your bag. Lufthansa's partner Dolfi1920 then decides on repair, replacement or payment.

airlines.carry_note: Lufthansa allows two [power banks](can-i-carry/power-bank.html) of up to 100 Wh, only in your cabin bag and never in the overhead locker; see our [power bank guide](../guides/power-bank-rules-on-flights.html). When you change planes in Frankfurt or Munich, the 100 ml liquids rule applies to your cabin bag, so pack [pickle](can-i-carry/pickle.html), ghee-based [sweets and home food](can-i-carry/sweets-and-home-food.html) and wet [masala](can-i-carry/spices-and-masala.html) in your checked bag.

On the Economy Basic (hand baggage only) fare there is no free checked bag for the baby, and you can't buy extra baggage on an infant ticket. Each infant and child can also check in two of these for free, even on Economy Basic: a fully folding pushchair, a car or booster seat, a travel cot or a baby back carrier. points: Prices from BA's baggage calculator, Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad or Chennai to London, read 28 Nov 2026. Economy: the 3rd and 4th bag cost ₹16,975 each online, or ₹20,010 (3rd) and ₹20,005 (4th) at the airport.
Economy Basic from India to London: the 1st and 2nd bag cost ₹9,700 each online or ₹11,520 at the airport; the 3rd and 4th bag ₹16,975 online or ₹20,005 at the airport.
Delhi to New York or Toronto via London, Economy: a 3rd bag costs ₹15,765 online or ₹21,220 at the airport.

Coming back: London to Delhi, a 3rd Economy bag costs GBP 140 online or GBP 165 at the airport (GBP 80 / GBP 95 for the 1st bag on Economy Basic). From New York it is USD 170 / USD 215, and from Toronto CAD 170 / CAD 215.

Heavy bag charge: GBP 65, EUR 75, USD 100 or CAD 100 for each bag of 23 to 32 kg, per one-way journey. From India the GBP price is turned into rupees. At Heathrow and many other airports you can pay only by card, not cash or Avios.

Add bags in Manage My Booking before check-in to get the lower online price (card, Avios or both). You can add up to 10 extra bags, for personal items only, if there is space. After check-in only the airport price is offered. Local taxes may be added.
Prepaid extra bags can be refunded if you cancel them before the flight leaves. If you booked through a travel agent, you can add bags only after the agent finishes the booking.

Oversize bags up to 190 x 75 x 65 cm usually go within your allowance. Tell BA when you book or at least 48 hours before, and drop the bag at the oversize bag desk at least 90 minutes before the flight. TVs and computer monitors are not taken as baggage.

notes: Power banks: up to two per person, each up to 100 Wh, with the capacity printed on them, in your hand baggage only. You can't charge a power bank from the seat power, and it must stay in the seat pocket or in a bag under the seat in front, not in the overhead locker. If your cabin bag goes in the hold, take power banks and spare batteries out first.

Spare batteries: at most four per person (two of them may be power banks), each up to 100 Wh, protected from short circuit. Batteries of 100 to 160 Wh need BA's approval before you fly. E-scooters, hoverboards and other small electric vehicles are not allowed at all.

Liquids: at Heathrow and Gatwick the new scanners let you keep liquids in containers up to 2 litres in your cabin bag. Other airports, including those in India, may still apply the 100 ml rule, so check the airport you leave from.
Flights to the USA: powders such as spices, flour, coffee or milk powder over 350 g go in checked baggage, not the cabin bag.
Alcohol: drinks under 24% have no BA limit; up to 5 litres between 24% and 70% in checked baggage (or duty-free in the cabin). Over 70% is not allowed.
You can't pool or share your checked allowance with another traveller, even on the same booking.
Bags on separate bookings are not sent through. Collect them and check them in again for the next flight.

sections.h: How British Airways differs from other airlines from India
items: Its cabin bag can be bigger than on most airlines from India (56 x 45 x 25 cm against 55 x 40 x 20 cm on Air India) and has no published weight limit, but you must lift it yourself.
Every passenger also gets a small handbag or backpack (40 x 30 x 15 cm), even on Economy Basic.
It counts pieces, not kilos: each bag is up to 23 kg in Economy, and you can't share kilos between bags.
Economy Basic includes no checked bag at all. Adding one from India costs ₹9,700 online.
Pets never fly in the cabin. Air India lets small cats and dogs fly in the Economy cabin.
Golf bags, skis, snowboards, diving kit and bicycles go as one of your checked bags if they fit the size and weight limits. On Economy Basic, or after your free bags, you pay the extra bag price.
Bike boxes and bags may be up to 190 x 95 x 65 cm; ski and golf bags up to 190 x 75 x 65 cm. Surfboards up to 240 cm long and 75 cm wide, under 23 kg, are also taken.
Tell BA by online chat as soon as you book, and at least 72 hours before you fly. On long-haul flights, drop oversize sports bags at the oversize bag desk at least 3 hours before departure.
A tennis or badminton racket case (up to 2 rackets, under 80 x 45 x 10 cm) can be one of your two cabin items. Cricket kit isn't listed separately; bats and hockey sticks must go in the hold.

Pets: BA doesn't carry pets in the cabin on any route. Pets fly in the hold, booked through IAG Cargo (to the UK) or PetAir UK (from the UK). Trained assistance dogs can fly free in the cabin on most flights; emotional support dogs can't.

BA doesn't publish a separate check-in closing time for Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad or Chennai. Its rule for long-haul international airports is that check-in closes at least 60 minutes before departure, and some airports close at 90 minutes.
Your exact closing time is shown in Manage My Booking, under Check in and then Other ways to check in.
Online and app check-in open 24 hours before the flight. You must be at the gate at least 20 minutes before departure.
Everyone changing planes at Heathrow goes through security again. Heathrow says liquids up to 2 litres and large electronics can stay in your cabin bag when you connect.
Duty-free liquids bought in India are allowed only if they stay sealed in the security bag with the receipt inside.

On one booking, your bags go through to your final stop. On separate bookings they don't: you collect them, go through UK immigration, and check in again. For separate tickets BA advises at least 4 hours between flights at Heathrow.

Neither BA nor Heathrow publishes one minimum connection time. BA says the time for connections on one ticket is shown in your itinerary in Manage My Booking. Free buses link Terminals 3 and 5; allow about 20 minutes to reach Terminal 5 B and C gates.
If your next flight is to a UK city or Ireland, you go through passport control first Flights to Ireland from Terminal 5 also need a UK ETA.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed or damaged
items: Report a missing bag at the baggage desk before you leave the airport, or on BA's online baggage portal. BA says delayed bags should be reported within 8 days of your flight. You get a report number of five letters and five numbers, such as JFKBA12345, to track the bag online.
To claim, a missing bag must be reported within 21 days, and damage or missing contents within 7 days of getting your bag back. Keep the damaged bag.
BA says it returns most missing bags within 72 hours and delivers them free to the address you choose. Keep receipts for essentials you buy while waiting; you can claim a reasonable amount.
BA doesn't pay for jewellery, money or other valuables packed in checked bags, or for electronics lost from the hold. Damage from a US TSA bag check is claimed from the TSA.

faq_extra.q: What is the British Airways baggage allowance from India to the UK?
faq_extra.a: BA's baggage calculator (read 28 Nov 2026) shows 2 checked bags of 23 kg each in Economy and Premium Economy between India and London, and none on Economy Basic. You also get a cabin bag up to 56 x 45 x 25 cm and a small handbag.

faq_extra.q: What is the British Airways baggage allowance from India to the USA?
faq_extra.a: For Delhi to New York via London, BA's calculator shows 2 bags of 23 kg each in Economy. Between London and the USA, Economy is only 1 bag, so check your own ticket in Manage My Booking.

faq_extra.q: What is the British Airways cabin baggage size?
faq_extra.a: One cabin bag up to 56 x 45 x 25 cm, wheels and handles included, plus one handbag or backpack up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm that fits under the seat.

faq_extra.q: What is the British Airways cabin baggage weight limit?
faq_extra.a: British Airways publishes no weight limit for cabin bags. You must be able to lift your bag into the overhead locker by yourself.

faq_extra.q: What is the British Airways checked baggage weight limit?
faq_extra.a: 23 kg per bag in Economy and Premium Economy, and 32 kg per bag in Business and First. No bag may weigh more than 32 kg; a bag of 23 to 32 kg in Economy pays GBP 65 (USD 100) each way.

faq_extra.q: Can you combine baggage allowance on British Airways?
faq_extra.a: No. BA says you can't pool, share or combine your checked allowance with another traveller, even in your own group. The 23 kg limit is also per bag, so you can't move kilos from one bag to another.

faq_extra.q: How do I track my British Airways baggage?
faq_extra.a: When you report a missing bag, BA gives you a report number such as JFKBA12345. Use it on BA's online baggage portal to check the status of the bag and update your delivery address.

Liquid foods like [pickle](can-i-carry/pickle.html) follow the liquid rules in the cabin, so pack them in checked bags. faq_extra.q: How much does an oversized bag cost on Turkish Airlines?

sections.h: How IndiGo abroad differs from IndiGo at home
items: The cabin bag is the same: 7 kg and 55 x 35 x 25 cm including wheels, plus a 3 kg personal item. A bag that flies with you to Goa flies to Dubai.

Lite fares have no checked bag at all abroad, and the add-on is a flat ₹3,500 for 20 kg, the same online and at the airport.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged

faq_extra.q: What are IndiGo international excess baggage charges?

faq_extra.q: What happens to baggage on an IndiGo international to domestic connection?

faq_extra.q: When does IndiGo web check-in open for international flights?

sections.h: How Air India abroad differs from IndiGo and the Gulf airlines
items: Its cabin bag is 55 x 40 x 20 cm: wider than IndiGo's 35 cm but thinner than IndiGo's 25 cm. Measure the depth of a hard trolley, which is often 23 to 25 cm.
Every fare, even Value, includes checked baggage abroad (25 kg to the Gulf). IndiGo Lite, Etihad Basic and flydubai Lite include none.
To the USA, the UK and Europe Air India counts pieces: 1 bag on Value and 2 on Classic and Flex, each up to 23 kg. Emirates and Qatar Airways count kilos to the UK and Europe.
Its power bank limit is 100 Wh, against 160 Wh on IndiGo.
Small cats and dogs can fly in the Economy cabin. IndiGo doesn't carry pets at all, and Emirates, Qatar Airways and flydubai don't take them in the cabin.

sections.h: Air India baggage to the USA and Canada
items: Economy Value includes 1 bag of 23 kg; Classic, Flex and Premium Economy include 2 bags of 23 kg each; Business 2 bags of 32 kg.
In Economy, both bags together may add up to 271 cm (length + width + height), and each bag up to 158 cm. A large and a medium trolley together are often over that, so measure both bags.
An extra bag from India costs USD 240 to the USA and CAD 360 to Canada at the airport; a bag of 23 to 32 kg pays USD 130 or CAD 190 more.
On flights to the USA, powders such as spices, flour, coffee or baby formula over 350 ml in your cabin bag get extra screening and may be refused. Put them in your checked bag.

sections.h: Sports gear, musical instruments and TVs
items: Sports equipment counts in your free allowance and also pays a handling fee: USD 45 on international flights (CAD 63.50 on Canada flights). The fee is waived on Economy Flex, Premium Economy Flex, Business and First, but not on award tickets.
Golf sets, cricket kits, bicycles (packed in a bike case), skis, fishing gear and archery sets are accepted, up to 2 items each, 300 cm in total and 32 kg.
Small musical instruments can go in the cabin as your one cabin bag. Bigger ones are checked in, up to 158 cm and 32 kg, or travel on a seat you buy (up to 75 kg).
Up to 2 LED or LCD TVs per person: up to 99 cm (39 inches) they go free within your allowance; from 99 to 139 cm an oversize charge applies; bigger TVs aren't accepted.
Only cats and dogs. A pet weighing up to 10 kg together with its soft kennel can fly with you in the Economy cabin, in the aisle seats of the last rows, one pet per passenger.

The soft kennel may be at most 17 x 10 x 9 inches (about 43 x 25 x 23 cm), leak-proof, ventilated on three sides and without wheels. Pets must be at least 8 weeks old, and pregnant or sedated pets aren't accepted.
Book through Air India's customer support or an airport or city office, with the pet's documents, at least 48 hours before the flight, and reach the airport 3 hours early.
Pets of 10 to 32 kg travel as checked baggage or cargo, depending on the aircraft, and pets over 32 kg only as cargo. Check the entry rules of the country you fly to.

Web check-in opens 48 hours before the flight and closes 2 hours before an international flight. You get a confirmation slip, and still show your passport at the counter or bag drop. It isn't available on codeshare flights.

At Delhi Terminal 3, Air India's check-in counters for international flights stay open until 75 minutes before departure. Air India's pages for Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kochi and Kolkata give no closing time, so check your ticket.
Delhi Airport advises international passengers to arrive at least 3 hours before departure.
In Delhi you can also check in and drop bags at the city check-in at the Airport Express metro station; boarding gates close 20 minutes before departure.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed, lost or damaged
items: Report it to Air India staff in the arrivals hall before you leave, and keep your copy of the Property Irregularity Report. You can follow the bag on WorldTracer.
A bag is treated as lost if it isn't traced within 21 days of the report. Claims need a list of what was inside, with the age of each item and proof of purchase.

Air India may pay essential expenses while a bag is delayed; ask customer support before you spend. It isn't responsible for normal wear, or for cash, jewellery, electronics or fragile items packed in checked bags.

sections.h: Maharaja Club and Star Alliance extras
items: Platinum and Gold members (Star Alliance Gold) get one extra 23 kg bag on piece routes or 20 kg more on weight routes, also on Star Alliance flights.
Silver members get 5 kg more on weight routes, on flights run by Air India only. Red tier gets no extra baggage.
No extra allowance on Air India's ATR and CRJ aircraft or on codeshare flights run by partners.

faq_extra.q: What is the Air India international baggage allowance for economy class?

faq_extra.q: What is the Air India international cabin baggage size?

faq_extra.q: What is the Air India baggage allowance to the USA?

faq_extra.q: What are Air India international excess baggage charges per kg?

faq_extra.q: What is the Air India premium economy baggage allowance on international flights?

faq_extra.q: What is the Air India baggage allowance to Europe and the UK?
faq_extra.a: Europe and the UK use pieces: 1 bag of 23 kg on Economy Value and 2 bags of 23 kg on Classic and Flex. An extra bag costs USD 240 to the UK and USD 220 to Germany, France, Italy and the Netherlands at the airport.

faq_extra.q: Does Air India give extra baggage for students on international flights?
faq_extra.a: Yes, on the Student fare (choose Student as the concession type when you book). Read on 28 Nov 2026: Economy gets 10 kg more than the Value fare on weight routes, up to 40 kg, and 2 bags of 23 kg on piece routes such as the USA, Canada and Europe. It is for full-time students aged 12 to 30, who may be asked for a student ID, visa or admission letter at the airport.

sections.h: How Air India Express differs from Air India and other airlines from India
items: Air India Express and Air India are sister airlines with different baggage rules. Check the airline name on your ticket, not just the flight number.

Cabin: Air India Express allows 7 kg in total for two items (a 56 x 36 x 23 cm bag and a 40 x 30 x 10 cm bag). Air India allows one 7 kg bag of 55 x 40 x 20 cm plus a separate personal item of up to 3 kg.
Checked: Air India Express Value includes 30 kg to the Gulf, more than Air India Value's 25 kg. But Xpress Lite includes no checked bag at all.
Air India Express doesn't fly to the USA, Canada, the UK or Europe, so it has no piece rules.
Air India Express doesn't carry pets (only service animals). Air India carries small cats and dogs in the cabin.
Both allow two power banks of up to 100 Wh in the cabin, and neither lets you use them on board.

Sports equipment counts in your baggage allowance, and kilos over the allowance pay the normal excess rate. Bicycles, golf bags, skis, surfboards, snowboards, scuba gear, large musical instruments and big TVs also pay a special handling fee: INR 3,500 (AED 160) per piece if pre-booked, INR 4,000 (AED 180) at the airport.
You can pre-book the handling fee for up to three pieces until 2 hours before departure. When you pay it, the extra piece fee doesn't apply to that item.

A bicycle must be packed in a bike bag or box, with handlebars turned in, pedals removed and tyres let down. A golf bag may hold up to 14 clubs. Diving gear may weigh up to 32 kg per bag, with the air tank empty and the valve open.
Small musical instruments can go in the cabin within the cabin bag rules; bigger ones go in the hold or on a seat you buy.
Pets are not allowed, in the cabin or as checked baggage. Trained service animals such as guide dogs may be accepted in the cabin if you contact Air India Express at least 48 hours before the flight.
Check-in counters open 3 hours before departure and close 60 minutes before. For flights from Delhi and from Kuwait they close 75 minutes before.
Air India Express's international flights page says counters close 60 to 90 minutes before departure, depending on the airport, and asks you to arrive at least 3 hours early.
Web check-in opens 14 days before departure. Even after web check-in, international passengers must go to the counter or bag drop to have their passport and visa checked.
The boarding gate closes 25 minutes before departure.

Air India Express has no foreign hub. A connecting trip is two of its own flights on one booking (it calls this Fly-Thru), with 50 minutes to 12 hours between them, for example from the UAE to Kathmandu, Bangkok, Phuket or Singapore through an Indian airport.

If a delay makes you miss a Fly-Thru connection and the next flight is the next day, you must collect your bags and check them in again. Two separate bookings don't count as a connecting trip, so plan for collecting and rechecking bags.
On a connecting trip, extra baggage is charged for each flight and paid at the start of the trip.

Its booking FAQ says Air India Express is a point-to-point airline without interline agreements with other airlines. It doesn't say whether bags can be checked through to an onward Air India flight, so ask at check-in. On its 'virtual interline' bookings with other airlines you collect and recheck your own bags.

Flying a domestic Air India Express flight to or from another airline's international flight? You can pre-book International Connecting Baggage: 8, 15 or 30 kg extra for INR 7,000, 12,500 or 25,000, if the flights are within 24 hours. Show the international boarding pass at the counter.

sections.h: If your bag is delayed or damaged
items: Report a missing or damaged bag at the Air India Express baggage desk in the arrivals hall before you leave, and get a Property Irregularity Report (PIR). If you leave without reporting it, the bag is taken as delivered in good condition.
Keep your boarding pass, bag tags and receipts for any costs you want to claim.

Send your written claim for damage within 7 days of getting the bag, and for a delayed bag within 21 days of the day it is given back to you. Write through the Tia chatbot or by letter to the Central Baggage Tracing Office at the airport you flew from.
Air India Express doesn't publish after how many days a missing bag is treated as lost.

For a fee you can add Bag Track and Protect (with Blue Ribbon Bags) when you book: it sends bag tracking updates and pays up to INR 1,32,000 for a delayed bag. You must report a delay to Blue Ribbon Bags within 24 hours of landing.
Air India Express isn't responsible for loss or damage to your handbag and things you keep with you.

faq_extra.q: What is the Air India Express baggage allowance for international flights?
faq_extra.a: Every fare includes 7 kg of cabin baggage in up to two items. Checked baggage is none on Xpress Lite, 30 kg on Value (20 kg to Thailand and Nepal), 30 to 35 kg on Flex and 40 kg on Biz.

faq_extra.q: What is the Air India Express baggage allowance from the UAE to India?
faq_extra.a: Its UAE website lists 30 kg on Value and Classic (20 kg on select routes), 35 kg on Flex (25 kg on select routes) and 40 kg on Biz. Lite has no checked bag. The cabin bag is 7 kg on all fares.

faq_extra.q: What is the Air India Express baggage allowance from Bahrain to India?
faq_extra.a: Its Bahrain website lists the same as the UAE: 30 kg on Value and Classic, 35 kg on Flex (lower on select routes), 40 kg on Biz and no checked bag on Lite. Extra kilos at Bahrain airport cost BHD 7 to 8 a kg.

faq_extra.q: What is the Air India Express cabin baggage size and weight limit on international flights?
faq_extra.a: 7 kg in total for two items: one bag up to 56 x 36 x 23 cm and one small bag up to 40 x 30 x 10 cm. Xtra Carry-On adds 3 kg (INR 3,600) or 5 kg (INR 6,000).

faq_extra.q: What are Air India Express excess baggage charges per kg?
faq_extra.a: At the airport, INR 1,500 to 1,650 a kg from India to most Gulf countries and INR 2,000 to Singapore and Thailand. From the UAE to India it is AED 68 to 75 a kg. Pre-booking online in 5 to 25 kg packs is usually cheaper.

faq_extra.q: What is the Air India Express child baggage allowance?
faq_extra.a: An infant under 2 gets 10 kg of checked baggage inside the adult's bags, plus a free stroller. The site shows no separate child rule: a child of 2 or more pays a fare and gets that fare's allowance.

faq_extra.q: Is the Air India vs Air India Express baggage allowance the same?
faq_extra.a: No. Air India Express gives 7 kg for two cabin items and 30 kg on Value to the Gulf. Air India gives one 7 kg cabin bag plus a 3 kg personal item and 25 kg on Value to the Gulf.

faq_extra.q: How can I track my Air India Express baggage?
faq_extra.a: If your bag doesn't arrive, report it at the arrivals baggage desk and keep the PIR reference. For live tracking updates, you can buy Bag Track and Protect when you book.

airlines.carry_note: Air India Express allows two [power banks](can-i-carry/power-bank.html) of up to 100 Wh, only in your cabin bag (see our [power bank guide](../guides/power-bank-rules-on-flights.html)). Its item list says [pickle](can-i-carry/pickle.html) is not allowed in any bag, so check before you pack it. For [spices](can-i-carry/spices-and-masala.html) and [sweets and home food](can-i-carry/sweets-and-home-food.html), dry items are the safest choice.
